params.until_date: Wait until this date before finalizing the reset.

AttachMenuBotIconColor.desc: Represents an attachment menu icon color for `bot mini apps » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`_

params.name: One of the following values: ``light_icon`` - Color of the attachment menu icon (light mode) ``light_text`` - Color of the attachment menu label, once selected (light mode) ``dark_icon`` - Color of the attachment menu icon (dark mode) ``dark_text`` - Color of the attachment menu label, once selected (dark mode)

AttachMenuBotIcon.desc: Represents an attachment menu icon for `bot mini apps » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`_

params.name: One of the following values: note that animated icons must be played when the user clicks on the button, activating the bot mini app. ``default_static`` - Default attachment menu icon in SVG format ``placeholder_static`` - Default placeholder for opened Web Apps in SVG format ``ios_static`` - Attachment menu icon in SVG format for the official iOS app ``ios_animated`` - Animated attachment menu icon in TGS format for the official iOS app ``android_animated`` - Animated attachment menu icon in TGS format for the official Android app ``macos_animated`` - Animated attachment menu icon in TGS format for the official native Mac OS app ``ios_side_menu_static`` - Side menu icon in PNG format for the official iOS app ``android_side_menu_static`` - Side menu icon in SVG format for the official android app ``macos_side_menu_static`` - Side menu icon in PNG format for the official native Mac OS app

AttachMenuBot.desc: Represents a `bot mini app that can be launched from the attachment/side menu » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`_

params.inactive: If set, before launching the mini app the client should ask the user to add the mini app to the attachment/side menu, and only if the user accepts, after invoking `messages.toggleBotInAttachMenu <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.toggleBotInAttachMenu>`_ the app should be opened.
params.request_write_access: Whether the bot would like to send messages to the user.
params.show_in_attach_menu: Whether, when installed, an attachment menu entry should be shown for the Mini App.
params.show_in_side_menu: Whether, when installed, an entry in the main view side menu should be shown for the Mini App.
params.side_menu_disclaimer_needed: If ``inactive`` if set and the user hasn't previously accepted the third-party mini apps `Terms of Service <https://telegram.org/tos/mini-apps>`_ for this bot, when showing the mini app installation prompt, an additional mandatory checkbox to accept the `mini apps TOS <https://telegram.org/tos/mini-apps>`_ and a disclaimer indicating that this Mini App is not affiliated to Telegram should be shown.
params.peer_types: List of dialog types where this attachment menu entry should be shown
params.icons: List of platform-specific static icons and animations to use for the attachment menu button

params.recommended: Whether the message needs to be labeled as "recommended" instead of "sponsored"
params.can_report: Whether this message can be `reported as specified here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages#reporting-sponsored-messages>`_.
params.random_id: Message ID. See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates#updatemessageid-updates>`_ for more info on random ID deduplication and updateMessageID mapping.
params.url: Contains the URL to open when the user clicks on the sponsored message.
params.title: Contains the title of the sponsored message.
params.photo: If set, contains a custom profile photo bubble that should be displayed for the sponsored message, like for messages sent in groups.
params.color: If set, the sponsored message should use the `message accent color » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors>`_ specified in ``color``.
params.button_text: Label of the sponsored message button.
params.sponsor_info: If set, contains additional information about the sponsor to be shown along with the message.
params.additional_info: If set, contains additional information about the sponsored message to be shown along with the message.
params.min_display_duration: For `sponsored messages to show on channel videos » <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages#getting-sponsored-video-advertisements>`_, allow the user to hide the ad only after the specified amount of seconds.
params.max_display_duration: For `sponsored messages to show on channel videos » <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages#getting-sponsored-video-advertisements>`_, autohide the ad after after the specified amount of seconds.

WebViewResultUrl.desc: Contains the webview URL with appropriate theme and user info parameters added

params.fullsize: If set, the app must be opened in fullsize mode instead of compact mode.
params.fullscreen: If set, the app must be opened in fullscreen
params.query_id: Webview session ID (only returned by `inline button mini apps <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps#inline-button-mini-apps>`_, `menu button mini apps <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps#menu-button-mini-apps>`_, `attachment menu mini apps <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps#attachment-menu-mini-apps>`_ ).

AttachMenuBotsBot.desc: Represents a `bot mini app that can be launched from the attachment menu » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`_

params.bot: Represents a `bot mini app that can be launched from the attachment menu » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`_
params.users: Info about related users and bots

messages.AvailableReactions.desc: Animations and metadata associated with `message reactions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/reactions>`_

params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_
params.reactions: Animations and metadata associated with `message reactions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/reactions>`_

account.SavedRingtoneConverted.desc: The notification sound was not in MP3 format and was successfully converted and saved, use the returned `Document <https://core.telegram.org/type/Document>`_ to refer to the notification sound from now on

NotificationSoundDefault.desc: Indicates the default notification sound should be used

MessagePeerReaction.desc: How a certain peer reacted to the message

params.big: Whether the specified `message reaction » <https://core.telegram.org/api/reactions>`_ should elicit a bigger and longer reaction
params.unread: Whether the reaction wasn't yet marked as read by the current user
params.my: Starting from layer 159, `messages.sendReaction <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendReaction>`_ will send reactions from the peer (user or channel) specified using `messages.saveDefaultSendAs <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.saveDefaultSendAs>`_. If set, this flag indicates that this reaction was sent by us, even if the ``peer`` doesn't point to the current account.
params.peer_id: Peer that reacted to the message

BotMenuButtonCommands.desc: `Bot menu button <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/menu>`_ that opens the bot command list when clicked.

NotificationSoundRingtone.desc: A specific previously uploaded notification sound should be used

params.id: Document ID of notification sound uploaded using `account.uploadRingtone <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.uploadRingtone>`_

AttachMenuPeerTypeBotPM.desc: The bot attachment menu entry is available in private chats with other bots (excluding the bot that offers the current attachment menu)

AttachMenuPeerTypeChat.desc: The bot attachment menu entry is available in `groups and supergroups <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_

AttachMenuPeerTypeSameBotPM.desc: The bot attachment menu entry is available in the chat with the bot that offers it

NotificationSoundNone.desc: No notification sound should be used

AttachMenuPeerTypePM.desc: The bot attachment menu entry is available in private chats with other users (not bots)

account.SavedRingtones.desc: A list of saved notification sounds

params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_

WebViewMessageSent.desc: Info about a sent inline webview message

messages.SponsoredMessages.desc: A set of sponsored messages associated to a channel

params.posts_between: If set, specifies the minimum number of messages between shown sponsored messages; otherwise, only one sponsored message must be shown after all ordinary messages.
params.start_delay: For `sponsored messages to show on channel videos » <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages#getting-sponsored-video-advertisements>`_, the number of seconds to wait before showing the first ad.
params.between_delay: For `sponsored messages to show on channel videos » <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages#getting-sponsored-video-advertisements>`_, the number of seconds to wait after the previous ad is hidden, before showing the next ad.
params.messages: Sponsored messages
params.chats: Chats mentioned in the sponsored messages
params.users: Users mentioned in the sponsored messages

BotMenuButton.desc: `Bot menu button <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/menu>`_ that opens a `web app <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps>`_ when clicked.

params.text: Title to be displayed on the menu button instead of 'Menu'
params.url: URL of a `web app <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps>`_ to open when the user clicks on the button

messages.MessageReactionsList.desc: List of peers that reacted to a specific message

params.count: Total number of reactions matching query
params.reactions: List of peers that reacted to a specific message
params.next_offset: If set, indicates the next offset to use to load more results by invoking `messages.getMessageReactionsList <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.getMessageReactionsList>`_.

params.min: Similar to `min <https://core.telegram.org/api/min>`_ objects, used for `message reaction » <https://core.telegram.org/api/reactions>`_ constructors that are the same for all users so they don't have the reactions sent by the current user (you can use `messages.getMessagesReactions <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.getMessagesReactions>`_ to get the full reaction info).
params.can_see_list: Whether `messages.getMessageReactionsList <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.getMessageReactionsList>`_ can be used to see how each specific peer reacted to the message
params.reactions_as_tags: If set or if there are no reactions, all present and future reactions should be treated as `message tags, see here » for more info <https://core.telegram.org/api/saved-messages#tags>`_.
params.recent_reactions: List of recent peers and their reactions
params.top_reactors: `Paid Telegram Star reactions leaderboard » <https://core.telegram.org/api/reactions#paid-reactions>`_ for this message.

account.SavedRingtonesNotModified.desc: The notification sound list hasn't changed.

InputInvoiceStarGiftPrepaidUpgrade.desc: `Separately prepay for the upgrade of a gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#prepaying-for-someone-elses-upgrade>`_.

params.peer: The peer that owns the gift.
params.hash: The upgrade hash from `messageActionStarGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionStarGift>`_. ``prepaid_upgrade_hash`` or `savedStarGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/savedStarGift>`_. ``prepaid_upgrade_hash``.

AttachMenuBotsNotModified.desc: The list of bot mini apps hasn't changed

InputInvoiceStarGiftTransfer.desc: Used to `pay to transfer a collectible gift to another peer <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#transferring-collectible-gifts>`_, see the `gifts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#transferring-collectible-gifts>`_ documentation for more info.

params.stargift: The identifier of the received gift

InputInvoiceChatInviteSubscription.desc: Used to pay for a `Telegram Star subscription » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#star-subscriptions>`_.

params.hash: The `invitation link of the Telegram Star subscription » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#star-subscriptions>`_

InputStorePaymentAuthCode.desc: Indicates payment for a login code.

params.restore: Set this flag to restore a previously made purchase.
params.premium_days: Duration in days of the `Telegram Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ subscription granted by this purchase, as indicated in `auth.sentCodePaymentRequired <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/auth.sentCodePaymentRequired>`_. ``premium_days``.
params.amount: Price of the product in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of ``US$ 1.45`` pass ``amount = 145``. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`_, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

InputStorePaymentStarsGift.desc: Used to gift `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ to a friend.

params.user_id: The user to which the stars should be gifted.
params.stars: Amount of stars to gift
params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of ``US$ 1.45`` pass ``amount = 145``. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`_, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

InputInvoiceStarGiftDropOriginalDetails.desc: Used to pay for for the removal of the `starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails>`_ attribute from a collectible gift, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#dropping-the-original-details-of-an-upgraded-gift>`_ for the full flow.

params.stargift: The collectible gift whose `starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails>`_ attribute should be removed.

account.SavedRingtone.desc: The notification sound was already in MP3 format and was saved without any modification

NotificationSoundLocal.desc: Indicates a specific local notification sound should be used

params.title: Notification sound title
params.data: Notification sound identifier (arbitrary data used by the client to identify a specific local notification sound)

InputStorePaymentPremiumGiveaway.desc: Used to pay for a `giveaway, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_ for more info.

params.only_new_subscribers: If set, only new subscribers starting from the giveaway creation date will be able to participate to the giveaway.
params.winners_are_visible: If set, giveaway winners are public and will be listed in a `messageMediaGiveawayResults <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageMediaGiveawayResults>`_ message that will be automatically sent to the channel once the giveaway ends.
params.boost_peer: The channel/supergroup starting the giveaway, that the user must join to participate, that will receive the giveaway `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_; see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_ for more info on giveaways.
params.additional_peers: Additional channels that the user must join to participate to the giveaway can be specified here.
params.countries_iso2: The set of users that can participate to the giveaway can be restricted by passing here an explicit whitelist of up to `giveaway_countries_max <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#giveaway-countries-max>`_ countries, specified as two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.
params.prize_description: Can contain a textual description of additional giveaway prizes.
params.random_id: Random ID to avoid resending the giveaway. See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates#updatemessageid-updates>`_ for more info on random ID deduplication and updateMessageID mapping.
params.until_date: The end date of the giveaway, must be at most `giveaway_period_max <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#giveaway-period-max>`_ seconds in the future; see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_ for more info on giveaways.
params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of ``US$ 1.45`` pass ``amount = 145``. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`_, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

InputInvoiceMessage.desc: An invoice contained in a `messageMediaInvoice <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageMediaInvoice>`_ message or `paid media » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-media>`_.

params.peer: Chat where the invoice/paid media was sent

InputInvoiceBusinessBotTransferStars.desc: Transfer stars from the balance of a user account `connected to a business bot <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_, to the balance of the `business bot <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#transferring-stars-from-a-business-account-to-the-business-bot>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.bot: Always `inputUserSelf <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputUserSelf>`_.
params.stars: The number of stars to transfer.

InputInvoiceStarGiftUpgrade.desc: Used to `pay to upgrade a Gift to a collectible gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#upgrade-a-gift-to-a-collectible-gift>`_, see the `collectible gifts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ documentation for more info on the full flow.

params.keep_original_details: Set this flag to keep the original gift text, sender and receiver in the upgraded gift as a `starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails>`_ attribute.
params.stargift: The identifier of the received gift to upgrade.

AttachMenuBots.desc: Represents a list of `bot mini apps that can be launched from the attachment menu » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`_

params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_
params.bots: List of `bot mini apps that can be launched from the attachment menu » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/attach>`_

InputInvoiceStarGiftResale.desc: Used to buy a `collectible gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ currently up on resale, see `here <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.slug: Slug of the gift to buy.

AttachMenuPeerTypeBroadcast.desc: The bot attachment menu entry is available in channels

InputInvoicePremiumGiftCode.desc: Used if the user wishes to start a channel/supergroup `giveaway <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_ or send some `giftcodes <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_ to members of a channel/supergroup, in exchange for `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_.

params.purpose: Should be populated with `inputStorePaymentPremiumGiveaway <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputStorePaymentPremiumGiveaway>`_ for `giveaways <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_ and `inputStorePaymentPremiumGiftCode <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputStorePaymentPremiumGiftCode>`_ for `gifts <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_.
params.option: Should be populated with one of the giveaway options returned by `payments.getPremiumGiftCodeOptions <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getPremiumGiftCodeOptions>`_, see the `giveaways » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_ documentation for more info.

InputInvoicePremiumAuthCode.desc: Used to pay for login codes, in case of high cost of SMS verification codes for the user's country/provider, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auth#paid-auth>`_ for more info.

params.status_text: Description of the current state of the user's Telegram Premium subscription
params.video_sections: A list of `premium feature identifiers » <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_, associated to each video

InputInvoiceSlug.desc: An invoice slug taken from an `invoice deep link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#invoice-links>`_ or from the `premium_invoice_slug app config parameter » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#premium-invoice-slug>`_

params.slug: The invoice slug

InputInvoiceStars.desc: Used to top up the `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ balance of the current account or someone else's account, or to start a `Telegram Star giveaway » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways#star-giveaways>`_.

InputStorePaymentPremiumGiftCode.desc: Used to gift `Telegram Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ subscriptions only to some specific subscribers of a channel/supergroup or to some of our contacts, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_ for more info on giveaways and gifts.

params.users: The users that will receive the `Telegram Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ subscriptions.
params.boost_peer: If set, the gifts will be sent on behalf of a channel/supergroup we are an admin of, which will also assign some `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ to it. Otherwise, the gift will be sent directly from the currently logged in user, and we will gain some extra `boost slots <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_. See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_ for more info on giveaways and gifts.
params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of ``US$ 1.45`` pass ``amount = 145``. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`_, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

InputStorePaymentPremiumSubscription.desc: Info about a Telegram Premium purchase

params.restore: Pass true if this is a restore of a Telegram Premium purchase; only for the App Store
params.upgrade: Pass true if this is an upgrade from a monthly subscription to a yearly subscription; only for App Store

params.url: URL to open in a webview to process the payment
params.title: Payment method description

account.EmojiStatusesNotModified.desc: The server-side list of `emoji statuses <https://core.telegram.org/api/emoji-status>`_ hasn't changed

InputInvoiceStarGiftAuctionBid.desc: Used to place a bid in a `collectible gift auction » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_.

params.hide_name: If set, your name will be hidden if the destination peer decides to display the gift on their profile (they will still see that you sent the gift). Must not be set when updating an existing bid, as the value cannot be changed for existing bids.
params.update_bid: Must be set when increasing an already existing bid.
params.peer: Identifier of the user or channel (only if `channelFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channelFull>`_. ``stargifts_available`` is set) that will receive the gift.
params.bid_amount: Total amount of the bid in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_.
params.message: Optional message that will be attached with the gift if we end up winning this round: the maximum length for this field is specified in the `stargifts_message_length_max client configuration value » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#stargifts-message-length-max>`_. Must not be set when updating an existing bid, as the value cannot be changed for existing bids.

EmojiStatusCollectible.desc: An owned or `hosted collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#hosted-collectible-gifts>`_ as emoji status.

params.document_id: ID of the `custom emoji <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ representing the status.
params.title: Name of the collectible.
params.slug: Unique identifier of the collectible that may be used to create a `collectible gift link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#collectible-gift-link>`_ for the current collectible, or to fetch further info about the collectible using `payments.getUniqueStarGift <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getUniqueStarGift>`_.
params.pattern_document_id: The ID of a pattern to apply on the profile's backdrop, correlated to the `starGiftAttributePattern <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributePattern>`_ from the gift in ``slug``.
params.center_color: Color of the center of the profile backdrop in RGB24 format, from the gift's `starGiftAttributeBackdrop <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeBackdrop>`_.
params.edge_color: Color of the edges of the profile backdrop in RGB24 format, from the gift's `starGiftAttributeBackdrop <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeBackdrop>`_.
params.pattern_color: Color of the ``pattern_document_id`` applied on the profile backdrop in RGB24 format, from the gift's `starGiftAttributeBackdrop <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeBackdrop>`_.
params.text_color: Color of text on the profile backdrop in RGB24 format, from the gift's `starGiftAttributeBackdrop <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeBackdrop>`_.
params.until: If set, the emoji status will be active until the specified unixtime.

InputInvoiceStarGift.desc: Used to buy a `Telegram Star Gift, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ for more info.

params.hide_name: If set, your name will be hidden if the destination user decides to display the gift on their profile (they will still see that you sent the gift)
params.include_upgrade: Also pay for an eventual upgrade of the gift to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.
params.message: Optional message, attached with the gift. The maximum length for this field is specified in the `stargifts_message_length_max client configuration value » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#stargifts-message-length-max>`_.

InputEmojiStatusCollectible.desc: An owned or `hosted collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#hosted-collectible-gifts>`_ as emoji status: can only be used in `account.updateEmojiStatus <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.updateEmojiStatus>`_, is never returned by the API.

params.until: If set, the emoji status will be active until the specified unixtime.

InputStorePaymentStarsTopup.desc: Used to top up the `Telegram Stars balance <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ of the current account.

params.stars: Amount of stars to topup
params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of ``US$ 1.45`` pass ``amount = 145``. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`_, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.spend_purpose_peer: Should be populated with the peer where the topup process was initiated due to low funds (i.e. a bot for bot payments, a channel for paid media/reactions, etc); leave this flag unpopulated if the topup flow was not initated when attempting to spend more Stars than currently available on the account's balance.

params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_

ChatReactionsAll.desc: All reactions or all non-custom reactions are allowed

params.pending: Whether the transcription is partial because audio transcription is still in progress, if set the user may receive further `updateTranscribedAudio <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updateTranscribedAudio>`_ updates with the updated transcription.
params.trial_remains_num: For non- `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ users, this flag will be set, indicating the remaining transcriptions in the free trial period.
params.trial_remains_until_date: For non- `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ users, this flag will be set, indicating the date when the ``trial_remains_num`` counter will be reset to the maximum value of `transcribe_audio_trial_weekly_number <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#transcribe-audio-trial-weekly-number>`_.

EmailVerifyPurposePassport.desc: Verify an email for use in `telegram passport <https://core.telegram.org/api/passport>`_

InputStorePaymentStarsGiveaway.desc: Used to pay for a `star giveaway, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways#star-giveaways>`_ for more info.

params.only_new_subscribers: If set, only new subscribers starting from the giveaway creation date will be able to participate to the giveaway.
params.winners_are_visible: If set, giveaway winners are public and will be listed in a `messageMediaGiveawayResults <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageMediaGiveawayResults>`_ message that will be automatically sent to the channel once the giveaway ends.
params.stars: Total number of Telegram Stars being given away (each user will receive ``stars/users`` stars).

Boost.desc: Info about one or more `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ applied by a specific user.

params.gift: Whether this boost was applied because the channel/supergroup `directly gifted a subscription to the user <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_.
params.giveaway: Whether this boost was applied because the user was chosen in a `giveaway started by the channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_.
params.unclaimed: If set, the user hasn't yet invoked `payments.applyGiftCode <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.applyGiftCode>`_ to claim a subscription gifted `directly or in a giveaway by the channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_.
params.id: Unique ID for this set of boosts.
params.user_id: ID of the user that applied the boost.
params.used_gift_slug: The created Telegram Premium gift code, only set if either ``gift`` or ``giveaway`` are set AND it is either a gift code for the currently logged in user or if it was already claimed.
params.multiplier: If set, this boost counts as ``multiplier`` boosts, otherwise it counts as a single boost.
params.stars: Number of Telegram Stars distributed among the winners of the giveaway.

params.months: Duration in months of each gifted `Telegram Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ subscription.
params.quantity: Number of given away `Telegram Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ subscriptions.

PrepaidStarsGiveaway.desc: Contains info about a `prepaid Telegram Star giveaway » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways#star-giveaways>`_.

params.stars: Number of given away `Telegram Stars » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_
params.boosts: Number of boosts the channel will gain by launching the giveaway.
params.date: When was the giveaway paid for

params.dark: Whether the reaction bubble has a dark background.
params.flipped: Whether the reaction bubble is mirrored (see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#reactions>`_ for more info).
params.coordinates: The coordinates of the media area corresponding to the reaction button.
params.reaction: The reaction that should be sent when this area is clicked.

StoryFwdHeader.desc: Contains info about the original poster of a reposted story.

params.modified: Whether the story media was modified before reposting it (for example by overlaying a round video with a reaction).
params.from: Peer that originally posted the story; will be empty for stories forwarded from a user with forwards privacy enabled, in which case ``from_name`` will be set, instead.
params.from_peer: Peer that originally posted the story; will be empty for stories forwarded from a user with forwards privacy enabled, in which case ``from_name`` will be set, instead.
params.from_name: Will be set for stories forwarded from a user with forwards privacy enabled, in which case ``from`` will also be empty.

StoriesStealthMode.desc: Information about the current `stealth mode <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#stealth-mode>`_ session.

params.active_until_date: The date up to which stealth mode will be active.
params.cooldown_until_date: The date starting from which the user will be allowed to re-enable stealth mode again.

stats.PublicForwards.desc: Contains info about the forwards of a `story <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_ as a message to public chats and reposts by public channels.

params.count: Total number of results
params.forwards: Info about the forwards of a story.

MediaAreaGeoPoint.desc: Represents a geolocation tag attached to a `story <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_.

params.coordinates: The size and position of the media area corresponding to the location sticker on top of the story media.
params.address: Optional textual representation of the address.

stories.StoryViewsList.desc: Reaction and view counters for a `story <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_

params.count: Total number of results that can be fetched
params.reactions_count: Number of reactions that were added to the story
params.views: Story view date and reaction information

PublicForwardStory.desc: Contains info about a forward of a `story <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_ as a repost by a public channel.

params.peer: The channel that reposted the story.
params.story: The reposted story (may be different from the original story).

premium.BoostsList.desc: List of `boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ that were applied to a peer by multiple users.

params.count: Total number of results
params.next_offset: Offset that can be used for `pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_.

params.forwards: Number of forwards and reposts to public chats and channels

params.color: `Color palette ID, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors>`_ for more info; if not set, the default palette should be used.
params.background_emoji_id: Optional `custom emoji ID <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ used to generate the pattern.

PublicForwardMessage.desc: Contains info about a forward of a `story <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_ as a message.

params.message: Info about the message with the reposted story.

params.hidden: Whether this palette should not be displayed as an option to the user when choosing a palette to apply to profile pages or message accents.
params.colors: Light mode palette. Will be empty for IDs ``0`` to ``6`` inclusive, in which case a palette containing a single color from the following colors should be used: red, orange, violet, green, cyan, blue, pink for indexes 0 to 6 (i.e. the same colors used for the `randomized fallback color palette <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors#randomized-fallback-color-palette>`_ ).
params.dark_colors: Dark mode palette. Optional, defaults to the palette in ``colors`` (or the autogenerated palette for IDs ``0`` to ``6`` ) if absent.
params.channel_min_level: Channels can use this palette only after reaching at least the `boost level <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ specified in this field.
params.group_min_level: Supergroups can use this palette only after reaching at least the `boost level <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ specified in this field.

params.views_graph: A graph containing the number of story views and shares
params.reactions_by_emotion_graph: A bar graph containing the number of story reactions categorized by "emotion" (i.e. Positive, Negative, Other, etc...)

params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_

help.PeerColorSet.desc: Represents a `color palette that can be used in message accents » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors>`_.

params.colors: A list of 1-3 colors in RGB format, describing the accent color.

params.forwards: Number of forwards to public channels

help.PeerColorProfileSet.desc: Represents a `color palette that can be used in profile pages » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors>`_.

params.palette_colors: A list of 1-2 colors in RGB format, shown in the color palette settings to describe the current palette.
params.bg_colors: A list of 1-2 colors in RGB format describing the colors used to generate the actual background used in the profile page.
params.story_colors: A list of 2 colors in RGB format describing the colors of the gradient used for the unread active story indicator around the profile photo.

PeerColorCollectible.desc: Represents a `color palette » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors>`_ associated to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors#collectible-gift-palettes>`_ for more info.

params.gift_emoji_id: `Custom emoji ID » <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ of the collectible gift: a single copy of this custom emoji should be displayed as-is (without recoloring it, unlike for ``background_emoji_id`` ) in the top-right corner of the palette.
params.background_emoji_id: `Custom emoji ID » <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ used to generate the pattern.
params.accent_color: Accent color in RGB24 format, used for reply backgrounds and the user's name in messages.
params.colors: 1-3 RGB24 colors to be used in the reply strip.
params.dark_accent_color: Accent color in RGB24 format, used for reply backgrounds and the user's name in messages in dark mode (fallback to ``accent_color`` if absent).
params.dark_colors: 1-3 RGB24 colors to be used in the reply strip in dark mode (fallback to ``colors`` if absent).

stories.StoryReactionsList.desc: List of peers that reacted to or intercated with a specific `story <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_

params.count: Total number of reactions matching query
params.reactions: List of peers that reacted to or interacted with a specific story
params.next_offset: If set, indicates the next offset to use to load more results by invoking `stories.getStoryReactionsList <https://core.telegram.org/method/stories.getStoryReactionsList>`_.

StoryReaction.desc: How a certain peer reacted to a story

params.coordinates: The size and location of the media area corresponding to the URL button on top of the story media.

InputPeerColorCollectible.desc: Represents a `color palette » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors>`_ associated to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors#collectible-gift-palettes>`_ for more info.

premium.MyBoosts.desc: A list of peers we are currently `boosting <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_, and how many `boost slots <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ we have left.

params.my_boosts: Info about boosted peers and remaining boost slots.

params.slug: ``slug`` from `starGiftUnique <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftUnique>`_. ``slug``, that can be resolved as `specified here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#sharing-and-getting-info-about-a-collectible-gift>`_.

SavedReactionTag.desc: Info about a `saved message reaction tag » <https://core.telegram.org/api/saved-messages#tags>`_.

params.title: Custom tag name assigned by the user (max 12 UTF-8 chars).
params.count: Number of messages tagged with this tag.
Number of `saved dialogs <https://core.telegram.org/api/saved-messages>`_ found server-side by the query

BusinessRecipients.desc: Specifies the chats that **can** receive Telegram Business `away » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`_ and `greeting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#greeting-messages>`_ messages.

params.users: Only private chats with the specified users.

BusinessWorkHours.desc: Specifies a set of `Telegram Business opening hours <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#opening-hours>`_.

params.open_now: Ignored if set while invoking `account.updateBusinessWorkHours <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.updateBusinessWorkHours>`_, only returned by the server in `userFull <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/userFull>`_. ``business_work_hours``, indicating whether the business is currently open according to the current time and the values in ``weekly_open`` and ``timezone``.
params.timezone_id: An ID of one of the timezones returned by `help.getTimezonesList <https://core.telegram.org/method/help.getTimezonesList>`_. The timezone ID is contained `timezone <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/timezone>`_. ``id``, a human-readable, localized name of the timezone is available in `timezone <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/timezone>`_. ``name`` and the `timezone <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/timezone>`_. ``utc_offset`` field contains the UTC offset in seconds, which may be displayed in hh:mm format by the client together with the human-readable name (i.e. ``$name UTC -01:00`` ).
params.weekly_open: A list of time intervals (max 28) represented by `businessWeeklyOpen » <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/businessWeeklyOpen>`_, indicating the opening hours of their business.

params.unread_mark: Whether this topic has a manually set (with `messages.markDialogUnread <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.markDialogUnread>`_ ) unread mark.
params.nopaid_messages_exception: If set, an admin has exempted this peer from payment to send messages using `account.toggleNoPaidMessagesException <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.toggleNoPaidMessagesException>`_.
params.peer: The peer associated to the topic, AKA the topic ID.
params.read_inbox_max_id: Position up to which all incoming messages are read.
params.read_outbox_max_id: Position up to which all outgoing messages are read.

MyBoost.desc: Contains information about a single `boost slot » <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_.

params.peer: If set, indicates this slot is currently occupied, i.e. we are `boosting <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ this peer. Note that we can assign multiple boost slots to the same peer.
params.date: When (unixtime) we started boosting the ``peer``, ``0`` otherwise.
params.expires: Indicates the (unixtime) expiration date of the boost in ``peer`` ( ``0`` if ``peer`` is not set).
params.cooldown_until_date: If ``peer`` is set, indicates the (unixtime) date after which this boost can be reassigned to another channel.

params.winner: Whether we're one of the winners of this giveaway.
params.refunded: Whether the giveaway was canceled and was fully refunded.
params.gift_code_slug: If we're one of the winners of this giveaway, contains the `Premium gift code <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#premium-giftcode-links>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_ for more info on the full giveaway flow.
params.stars_prize: If we're one of the winners of this `Telegram Star giveaway <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways#star-giveaways>`_, the number `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ we won.
params.finish_date: End date of the giveaway. May be bigger than the end date specified in parameters of the giveaway.
params.winners_count: Number of winners in the giveaway
params.activated_count: Number of winners, which activated their `gift codes <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#premium-giftcode-links>`_.

StoryReactionPublicForward.desc: A certain peer has forwarded the story as a message to a public chat or channel.

params.message: The message with the forwarded story.

messages.SavedReactionTags.desc: List of `reaction tag » <https://core.telegram.org/api/saved-messages#tags>`_ names assigned by the user.

params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_. Can also be manually regenerated, if needed, using the `custom algorithm specified here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/saved-messages#tags>`_.

StoryReactionPublicRepost.desc: A certain peer has reposted the story.

params.peer_id: The peer that reposted the story.

params.participating: The current user is participating in the giveaway.
params.preparing_results: If set, the giveaway has ended and the results are being prepared.
params.joined_too_early_date: The current user can't participate in the giveaway, because they were already a member of the channel when the giveaway started, and the ``only_new_subscribers`` was set when starting the giveaway.
params.admin_disallowed_chat_id: If set, the current user can't participate in the giveaway, because they are an administrator in one of the channels (ID specified in this flag) that created the giveaway.
params.disallowed_country: If set, the current user can't participate in this giveaway, because their phone number is from the specified disallowed country (specified as a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code).

help.PeerColorsNotModified.desc: The list of color palettes has not changed.

help.TimezonesListNotModified.desc: The timezone list has not changed.

help.TimezonesList.desc: Timezone information that may be used elsewhere in the API, such as to set `Telegram Business opening hours » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#opening-hours>`_.

params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_

params.messages: List of last messages from each saved dialog

payments.CheckedGiftCode.desc: Contains info about a `Telegram Premium giftcode link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#premium-giftcode-links>`_.

params.via_giveaway: Whether this giftcode was created by a `giveaway <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_.
params.from_id: The peer that created the gift code.
params.giveaway_msg_id: Message ID of the giveaway in the channel specified in ``from_id``.
params.to_id: The destination user of the gift.
params.date: Creation date of the gift code.
params.days: Duration of the gifted Telegram Premium subscription, in days.
params.used_date: When was the giftcode imported, if it was imported.

messages.SavedReactionTagsNotModified.desc: The list of `reaction tag » <https://core.telegram.org/api/saved-messages#tags>`_ names assigned by the user hasn't changed.

BusinessLocation.desc: Represents the location of a `Telegram Business » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#location>`_.

InputBusinessAwayMessage.desc: Describes a `Telegram Business away message <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`_, automatically sent to users writing to us when we're offline, during closing hours, while we're on vacation, or in some other custom time period when we cannot immediately answer to the user.

params.offline_only: If set, the messages will not be sent if the account was online in the last 10 minutes.
params.shortcut_id: ID of a `quick reply shorcut, containing the away messages to send, see here » for more info <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#quick-reply-shortcuts>`_.
params.schedule: Specifies when should the away messages be sent.
params.recipients: Allowed recipients for the away messages.

BusinessAwayMessage.desc: Describes a `Telegram Business away message <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`_, automatically sent to users writing to us when we're offline, during closing hours, while we're on vacation, or in some other custom time period when we cannot immediately answer to the user.

params.offline_only: If set, the messages will not be sent if the account was online in the last 10 minutes.
params.shortcut_id: ID of a `quick reply shorcut, containing the away messages to send, see here » for more info <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#quick-reply-shortcuts>`_.
params.schedule: Specifies when should the away messages be sent.
params.recipients: Allowed recipients for the away messages.

messages.SavedDialogsSlice.desc: Incomplete list of `saved message dialogs » <https://core.telegram.org/api/saved-messages>`_ with messages and auxiliary data.

params.count: Total number of saved message dialogs
params.messages: List of last messages from dialogs

BusinessGreetingMessage.desc: Describes a `Telegram Business greeting <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#greeting-messages>`_, automatically sent to new users writing to us in private for the first time, or after a certain inactivity period.

params.shortcut_id: ID of a `quick reply shorcut, containing the greeting messages to send, see here » for more info <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#quick-reply-shortcuts>`_.
params.recipients: Allowed recipients for the greeting messages.
params.no_activity_days: The number of days after which a private chat will be considered as inactive; currently, must be one of 7, 14, 21, or 28.

InputBusinessRecipients.desc: Specifies the chats that **can** receive Telegram Business `away » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`_ and `greeting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#greeting-messages>`_ messages.

params.users: Only private chats with the specified users.

messages.QuickRepliesNotModified.desc: Info about `quick reply shortcuts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#quick-reply-shortcuts>`_ hasn't changed.

InputBusinessGreetingMessage.desc: Describes a `Telegram Business greeting <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#greeting-messages>`_, automatically sent to new users writing to us in private for the first time, or after a certain inactivity period.

params.shortcut_id: ID of a `quick reply shorcut, containing the greeting messages to send, see here » for more info <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#quick-reply-shortcuts>`_.
params.recipients: Allowed recipients for the greeting messages.
params.no_activity_days: The number of days after which a private chat will be considered as inactive; currently, must be one of 7, 14, 21, or 28.

ConnectedBot.desc: Contains info about a `connected business bot » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_.

params.recipients: Specifies the private chats that a `connected business bot » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_ may receive messages and interact with.

params.title: Title of the introduction message (max `intro_title_length_limit » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#intro-title-length-limit>`_ UTF-8 characters).

InputBusinessBotRecipients.desc: Specifies the private chats that a `connected business bot » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_ may interact with.

params.contacts: Selects all private chats with contacts.
params.non_contacts: Selects all private chats with non-contacts.
params.exclude_selected: If set, then all private chats *except* the ones selected by ``existing_chats``, ``new_chats``, ``contacts``, ``non_contacts`` and ``users`` are chosen. Note that if this flag is set, any values passed in ``exclude_users`` will be merged and moved into ``users`` by the server.
params.exclude_users: Identifiers of private chats that are always excluded.

params.name: Human-readable and localized timezone name.
params.utc_offset: UTC offset in seconds, which may be displayed in hh:mm format by the client together with the human-readable name (i.e. ``$name UTC -01:00`` ).

OutboxReadDate.desc: Exact read date of a private message we sent to another user.

params.date: UNIX timestamp with the read date.

messages.MyStickers.desc: The list of `stickersets owned by the current account » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers>`_.

params.count: Total number of owned stickersets.

params.top_message: ID of the last message in the shortcut.
params.count: Total number of messages in the shortcut.

InputQuickReplyShortcut.desc: Selects a `quick reply shortcut <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#quick-reply-shortcuts>`_ by name.

InputQuickReplyShortcutId.desc: Selects a `quick reply shortcut <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#quick-reply-shortcuts>`_ by its numeric ID.

BusinessChatLink.desc: Contains info about a `business chat deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#business-chat-links>`_ created by the current account.

params.message: Message to pre-fill in the message input field.
params.title: Human-readable name of the link, to simplify management in the UI (only visible to the creator of the link).
params.views: Number of times the link was resolved (clicked/scanned/etc...).

BusinessWeeklyOpen.desc: A time interval, indicating the opening hours of a business.

params.start_minute: Start minute in minutes of the week, ``0`` to ``7*24*60`` inclusively.
params.end_minute: End minute in minutes of the week, ``1`` to ``8*24*60`` inclusively ( ``8`` and not ``7`` because this allows to specify intervals that, for example, start on ``Sunday 21:00`` and end on ``Monday 04:00`` ( ``6*24*60+21*60`` to ``7*24*60+4*60`` ) without passing an invalid ``end_minute < start_minute`` ). See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#opening-hours>`_ for more info.

BusinessAwayMessageScheduleCustom.desc: Send `Telegram Business away messages <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`_ to users writing to us in private in the specified time span.

BusinessAwayMessageScheduleAlways.desc: Always send `Telegram Business away messages <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`_ to users writing to us in private.

RequestedPeerChat.desc: Info about a `chat <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_, shared by a user with the currently logged in bot using `messages.sendBotRequestedPeer <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendBotRequestedPeer>`_.

BusinessBotRecipients.desc: Specifies the private chats that a `connected business bot » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_ may receive messages and interact with.

params.contacts: Selects all private chats with contacts.
params.non_contacts: Selects all private chats with non-contacts.
params.exclude_selected: If set, then all private chats *except* the ones selected by ``existing_chats``, ``new_chats``, ``contacts``, ``non_contacts`` and ``users`` are chosen. Note that if this flag is set, any values passed in ``exclude_users`` will be merged and moved into ``users`` by the server, thus ``exclude_users`` will always be empty.
params.exclude_users: Identifiers of private chats that are always excluded.

channels.SponsoredMessageReportResultCho.desc: The user must choose a report option from the localized options available in ``options``, and after selection, `messages.reportSponsoredMessage <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.reportSponsoredMessage>`_ must be invoked again, passing the option's ``option`` field to the ``option`` param of the method.

params.title: Title of the option selection popup.

params.messages: Messages mentioned in ``quick_replies``.

BusinessAwayMessageScheduleOutsideWorkHo.desc: Send `Telegram Business away messages <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#away-messages>`_ to users writing to us in private outside of the configured `Telegram Business working hours <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#opening-hours>`_.

params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of ``US$ 1.45`` pass ``amount = 145``. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`_, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.crypto_amount: Price, in the smallest units of the cryptocurrency.
params.url: `Fragment <https://fragment.com>`_ URL with more info about the collectible

MissingInvitee.desc: Info about why a specific user could not be `invited » <https://core.telegram.org/api/invites#direct-invites>`_.

params.premium_would_allow_invite: If set, we could not add the user *only because* the current account needs to purchase a `Telegram Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ subscription to complete the operation.
params.premium_required_for_pm: If set, we could not add the user because of their privacy settings, and additionally, the current account needs to purchase a `Telegram Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ subscription to directly share an invite link with the user via a private message.
params.user_id: ID of the user. If neither of the flags below are set, we could not add the user because of their privacy settings, and we can create and directly share an `invite link <https://core.telegram.org/api/invites#invite-links>`_ with them using a normal message, instead.

messages.InvitedUsers.desc: Contains info about successfully or unsuccessfully `invited » <https://core.telegram.org/api/invites#direct-invites>`_ users.

params.updates: List of updates about successfully invited users (and eventually info about the created group)
params.missing_invitees: A list of users that could not be invited, along with the reason why they couldn't be invited.

channels.SponsoredMessageReportResultAds.desc: Sponsored messages were hidden for the user in all chats.

account.BusinessChatLinks.desc: Contains info about `business chat deep links » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#business-chat-links>`_ created by the current account.

SponsoredMessageReportOption.desc: A `report option for a sponsored message » <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages#reporting-sponsored-messages>`_.

BotBusinessConnection.desc: Contains info about a `bot business connection <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_.

params.disabled: Whether this business connection is currently disabled
params.connection_id: Business connection ID, used to identify messages coming from the connection and to reply to them as specified `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_.
params.user_id: ID of the user that the bot is connected to via this connection.
params.dc_id: ID of the datacenter where to send queries wrapped in a `invokeWithBusinessConnection <https://core.telegram.org/method/invokeWithBusinessConnection>`_ as specified `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_.

ReactionNotificationsFromContacts.desc: Receive notifications about reactions made only by our contacts.

RequestedPeerUser.desc: Info about a user, shared by a user with the currently logged in bot using `messages.sendBotRequestedPeer <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendBotRequestedPeer>`_.

InputBusinessChatLink.desc: Contains info about a `business chat deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#business-chat-links>`_ to be created by the current account.

params.message: Message to pre-fill in the message input field.
params.title: Human-readable name of the link, to simplify management in the UI (only visible to the creator of the link).

StarsTransactionPeerUnsupported.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ transaction that cannot be described using the current layer.

StarsTransactionPeerAppStore.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ transaction with the App Store, used when purchasing Telegram Stars through the App Store.

channels.SponsoredMessageReportResultRep.desc: The sponsored message was reported successfully.

RequestedPeerChannel.desc: Info about a `channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_, shared by a user with the currently logged in bot using `messages.sendBotRequestedPeer <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendBotRequestedPeer>`_.

FactCheck.desc: Represents a `fact-check » <https://core.telegram.org/api/factcheck>`_ created by an independent fact-checker.

params.need_check: If set, the ``country`` / ``text`` fields will **not** be set, and the fact check must be fetched manually by the client (if it isn't already cached with the key specified in ``hash`` ) using bundled `messages.getFactCheck <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.getFactCheck>`_ requests, when the message with the factcheck scrolls into view.
params.country: A two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the country for which the fact-check should be shown.
params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_

messages.AvailableEffectsNotModified.desc: The full list of usable `animated message effects » <https://core.telegram.org/api/effects>`_ hasn't changed.

ReactionNotificationsFromAll.desc: Receive notifications about reactions made by any user.

StarsTransactionPeerAds.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ transaction used to pay for `Telegram ads as specified here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#paying-for-ads>`_.

FoundStory.desc: A story found using `global story search » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#searching-stories>`_.

params.peer: The peer that posted the story.

params.premium_required: Whether a `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ subscription is required to use this effect.
params.emoticon: Emoji corresponding to the effect, to be used as icon for the effect if ``static_icon_id`` is not set.
params.static_icon_id: ID of the document containing the static icon (WEBP) of the effect.
params.effect_sticker_id: Contains the preview `animation (TGS format ») <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers#animated-stickers>`_, used for the effect selection menu.
params.effect_animation_id: If set, contains the actual animated effect `(TGS format ») <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers#animated-stickers>`_. If not set, the animated effect must be set equal to the `premium animated sticker effect <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers#premium-animated-sticker-effects>`_ associated to the animated sticker specified in ``effect_sticker_id`` (always different from the preview animation, fetched thanks to the `videoSize <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/videoSize>`_ of type ``f`` as specified `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers#premium-animated-sticker-effects>`_ ).

StarsTransactionPeerFragment.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ transaction with `Fragment <https://fragment.com>`_, used when purchasing Telegram Stars through `Fragment <https://fragment.com>`_.

params.count: Total number of results found for the query.
params.next_offset: Offset used to fetch the next page, if not set this is the final page.

account.ResolvedBusinessChatLinks.desc: Contains info about a single resolved `business chat deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/business#business-chat-links>`_.

params.message: Message to pre-fill in the message input field.

params.extended: If set, the option must only be shown in the full list of topup options.
params.stars: Amount of Telegram stars.
params.store_product: Identifier of the store product associated with the option, official apps only.
params.amount: Price of the product in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of ``US$ 1.45`` pass ``amount = 145``. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`_, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

payments.StarsStatus.desc: Info about the current `Telegram Star subscriptions, balance and transaction history » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#balance-and-transaction-history>`_.

params.subscriptions: Info about current Telegram Star subscriptions, only returned when invoking `payments.getStarsTransactions <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getStarsTransactions>`_ and `payments.getStarsSubscriptions <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getStarsSubscriptions>`_.
params.subscriptions_next_offset: Offset for pagination of subscriptions: only usable and returned when invoking `payments.getStarsSubscriptions <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getStarsSubscriptions>`_.
params.subscriptions_missing_balance: The number of Telegram Stars the user should buy to be able to extend expired subscriptions soon (i.e. the current balance is not enough to extend all expired subscriptions).
params.history: List of Telegram Star transactions (partial if ``next_offset`` is set).
params.next_offset: Offset to use to fetch more transactions from the transaction history using `payments.getStarsTransactions <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getStarsTransactions>`_.

StarsTransactionPeerPlayMarket.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ transaction with the Play Store, used when purchasing Telegram Stars through the Play Store.

StarsTransactionPeer.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ transaction with another peer.

StarsTransactionPeerPremiumBot.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ transaction made using `@PremiumBot <https://t.me/premiumbot>`_ (i.e. using the `inputInvoiceStars <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputInvoiceStars>`_ flow described `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#buying-or-gifting-stars>`_ ).

params.period: The user should pay ``amount`` stars every ``period`` seconds to gain and maintain access to the channel. Currently the only allowed subscription period is ``30*24*60*60``, i.e. the user will be debited amount stars every month.
params.amount: Price of the subscription in Telegram Stars.

ReactionsNotifySettings.desc: Reaction notification settings, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/reactions#notifications-about-reactions>`_ for more info.

params.messages_notify_from: Message reaction notification settings, if not set completely disables notifications/updates about message reactions.
params.stories_notify_from: Story reaction notification settings, if not set completely disables notifications/updates about reactions to stories.
params.poll_votes_notify_from: `Non-anonymous poll vote » <https://core.telegram.org/api/poll#unread-poll-votes>`_ notification settings, if not set completely disables notifications/updates about votes cast in the user's non-anonymous polls.
params.show_previews: If false, `push notifications » <https://core.telegram.org/api/push-updates>`_ about message/story reactions will only be of type ``REACT_HIDDEN`` / ``REACT_STORY_HIDDEN``, without any information about the reacted-to story or the reaction itself.

params.withdrawal_enabled: If set, the user may `withdraw <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#withdrawing-revenue>`_ up to ``available_balance`` stars.
params.overall_revenue: Total amount of earned Telegram Stars.
params.next_withdrawal_at: Unixtime indicating when will withdrawal be available to the user. If not set, withdrawal can be started now.

InputStarsTransaction.desc: Used to fetch info about a `Telegram Star transaction » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#balance-and-transaction-history>`_.

params.refund: If set, fetches info about the refund transaction for this transaction.

params.extended: If set, the option must only be shown in the full list of topup options.
params.stars: Amount of Telegram stars.
params.store_product: Identifier of the store product associated with the option, official apps only.
params.amount: Price of the product in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of ``US$ 1.45`` pass ``amount = 145``. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`_, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).

params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_

payments.StarsRevenueStats.desc: `Star revenue statistics, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ for more info.

params.top_hours_graph: For ad revenue statistics, ad impressions graph
params.revenue_graph: Star revenue graph (number of earned stars)
params.status: Current balance, current withdrawable balance and overall earned Telegram Stars
params.usd_rate: Current conversion rate of Telegram Stars to USD

StarsTransaction.desc: Represents a `Telegram Stars or TON transaction » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_.

params.refund: Whether this transaction is a refund.
params.gift: This transaction was a gift from the user in ``peer.peer``.
params.stargift_upgrade: This transaction pays for the upgrade of a gift to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.
params.business_transfer: This transaction transfers stars from the balance of a user account `connected to a business bot <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_, to the balance of the business bot, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#transferring-stars-from-a-business-account-to-the-business-bot>`_ for more info.
params.stargift_resale: This transaction is related to the `resale of a collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`_.
params.posts_search: Represents payment for a `paid global post search » <https://core.telegram.org/api/search#posts-tab>`_.
params.stargift_prepaid_upgrade: Represents payment for a `separate prepaid upgrade of a gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#prepaying-for-someone-elses-upgrade>`_.
params.stargift_drop_original_details: Represents payment for the removal of the `starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails>`_ attribute from a gift, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#dropping-the-original-details-of-an-upgraded-gift>`_ for the full flow.
params.phonegroup_message: Represents payment for a paid text message sent during a `group call or live video stream » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls>`_.
params.stargift_auction_bid: Represents payment for placing a `collectible gift auction bid » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_.
params.offer: Represents payment for a `collectible gift purchase offer » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gift-purchase-offers>`_.
params.amount: Amount of Telegram Stars or TON.
params.peer: Source of the incoming transaction, or its recipient for outgoing transactions.
params.title: For transactions with bots, title of the bought product.
params.description: For transactions with bots, description of the bought product.
params.photo: For transactions with bots, photo of the bought product.
params.transaction_date: If neither ``pending`` nor ``failed`` are set, the transaction was completed successfully, and this field will contain the point in time (Unix timestamp) when the withdrawal was completed successfully.
params.transaction_url: If neither ``pending`` nor ``failed`` are set, the transaction was completed successfully, and this field will contain a URL where the withdrawal transaction can be viewed.
params.bot_payload: Bot specified invoice payload (i.e. the ``payload`` passed to `inputMediaInvoice <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputMediaInvoice>`_ when `creating the invoice <https://core.telegram.org/api/payments>`_ ).
params.msg_id: For `paid media transactions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-media>`_, message ID of the paid media posted to ``peer.peer`` (can point to a deleted message; either way, ``extended_media`` will always contain the bought media).
params.subscription_period: The number of seconds between consecutive Telegram Star debiting for `Telegram Star subscriptions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#star-subscriptions>`_.
params.giveaway_post_id: ID of the message containing the `messageMediaGiveaway <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageMediaGiveaway>`_, for incoming `star giveaway prizes <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways#star-giveaways>`_.
params.stargift: This transaction indicates a purchase or a sale (conversion back to Stars) of a `gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_.
params.floodskip_number: This transaction is payment for `paid bot broadcasts <https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq#how-can-i-message-all-of-my-bot-39s-subscribers-at-once>`_. Paid broadcasts are only allowed if the ``allow_paid_floodskip`` parameter of `messages.sendMessage <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendMessage>`_ and other message sending methods is set while trying to broadcast more than 30 messages per second to bot users. The integer value returned by this flag indicates the number of billed API calls.
params.starref_commission_permille: This transaction is the receival (or refund) of an `affiliate commission <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`_ (i.e. this is the transaction received by the peer that created the `referral link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#referral-links>`_, flag 17 is for transactions made by users that imported the referral link).
params.starref_peer: For transactions made by `referred users <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`_, the peer that received the affiliate commission.
params.starref_amount: For transactions made by `referred users <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`_, the amount of Telegram Stars received by the affiliate, can be negative for refunds.
params.paid_messages: This transaction is related to the reception or transmission of a `paid message » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`_.
params.premium_gift_months: This transaction indicates the payment for a `gifted Telegram Premium subscription » <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium#gifting-telegram-premium>`_.
params.ads_proceeds_from_date: Indicates that this is payment for ad revenue from the specified unixtime (always set together with **ads_proceeds_to_date** ).
params.ads_proceeds_to_date: Indicates that this is payment for ad revenue to the specified unixtime.

messages.AvailableEffects.desc: The full list of usable `animated message effects » <https://core.telegram.org/api/effects>`_.

params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_

StarsGiveawayOption.desc: Contains info about a `Telegram Star giveaway <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways#star-giveaways>`_ option.

params.extended: If set, this option must only be shown in the full list of giveaway options (i.e. they must be added to the list only when the user clicks on the expand button).
params.default: If set, this option must be pre-selected by default in the option list.
params.stars: The number of Telegram Stars that will be distributed among winners
params.yearly_boosts: Number of times the chat will be boosted for one year if the `inputStorePaymentStarsGiveaway <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputStorePaymentStarsGiveaway>`_. ``boost_peer`` flag is populated
params.store_product: Identifier of the store product associated with the option, official apps only.
params.amount: Total price in the smallest units of the currency (integer, not float/double). For example, for a price of ``US$ 1.45`` pass ``amount = 145``. See the exp parameter in `currencies.json <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments/currencies.json>`_, it shows the number of digits past the decimal point for each currency (2 for the majority of currencies).
params.winners: Allowed options for the number of giveaway winners.

params.can_refulfill: Whether we left the associated private channel, but we can still rejoin it using `payments.fulfillStarsSubscription <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.fulfillStarsSubscription>`_ because the current subscription period hasn't expired yet.
params.missing_balance: Whether this subscription has expired because there are not enough stars on the user's balance to extend it.
params.bot_canceled: Set if this `bot subscription <https://core.telegram.org/api/subscriptions#bot-subscriptions>`_ was cancelled by the bot
params.peer: Identifier of the associated private chat.
params.until_date: Expiration date of the current subscription period.
params.pricing: Pricing of the subscription in Telegram Stars.
params.chat_invite_hash: Invitation link, used to renew the subscription after cancellation or expiration.
params.title: For bot subscriptions, the title of the subscription invoice
params.photo: For bot subscriptions, the photo from the subscription invoice
params.invoice_slug: For bot subscriptions, the `identifier <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#invoice-links>`_ of the subscription invoice

ReportResultReported.desc: The report was sent successfully, no further actions are required.

params.count: Total number of active affiliations

payments.StarGiftsNotModified.desc: The list of available `gifts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ hasn't changed.

messages.BotPreparedInlineMessage.desc: Represents a `prepared inline message saved by a bot, to be sent to the user via a web app » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/inline#21-using-a-prepared-inline-message>`_

params.id: The ID of the saved message, to be passed to the ``id`` field of the `web_app_send_prepared_message event » <https://core.telegram.org/api/web-events#web-app-send-prepared-message>`_

BotPreviewMedia.desc: Represents a `Main Mini App preview media, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps#main-mini-app-previews>`_ for more info.

params.date: When was this media last updated.

params.option: Option identifier: if the user selects this option, re-invoke `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`_, passing this option to ``option``

StarsTransactionPeerAPI.desc: Describes a `Telegram Star <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ transaction used to pay for paid API usage, such as `paid bot broadcasts <https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq#how-can-i-message-all-of-my-bot-39s-subscribers-at-once>`_.

payments.StarsRevenueAdsAccountUrl.desc: Contains a URL leading to a page where the user will be able to place ads for the channel/bot, paying using `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#paying-for-ads>`_.

params.bot_id: ID of the bot that verified this peer

MessageReactor.desc: Info about a user in the `paid Star reactions leaderboard <https://core.telegram.org/api/reactions#paid-reactions>`_ for a message.

params.top: If set, the reactor is one of the most active reactors; may be unset if the reactor is the current user.
params.my: If set, this reactor is the current user.
params.anonymous: If set, the reactor is anonymous.
params.peer_id: Identifier of the peer that reacted: may be unset for anonymous reactors different from the current user (i.e. if the current user sent an anonymous reaction ``anonymous`` will be set but this field will also be set).
params.count: The number of sent Telegram Stars.

StarGiftAttributePattern.desc: A `sticker <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers>`_ applied on the backdrop of a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ using a repeating pattern.

StarGiftUnique.desc: Represents a `collectible star gift, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ for more info.

params.require_premium: This gift can only be bought by users with a `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ subscription.
params.resale_ton_only: Whether the gift can be bought only using Grams.
params.theme_available: A chat theme associated to this gift is available, `see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/themes#chat-themes>`_ for more info on how to use it.
params.burned: This gift was already used as an ingredient for `crafting another collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`_.
params.crafted: This collectible gift was obtained by `crafting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`_, not by upgrading a regular gift.
