params.id: Unique identifier of this collectible gift.
params.gift_id: ID of the regular gift from which this gift was upgraded (all collectible gifts upgraded from the same gift will have the same ``gift_id``, with different attributes).
params.title: Collectible title.
params.slug: Slug that can be used to create a `collectible gift deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#collectible-gift-link>`_, or `elsewhere in the API where a collectible slug is accepted <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_.
params.num: Unique identifier of this collectible gift among all (already upgraded) collectible gifts of the same type.
params.owner_name: The name of the owner if neither ``owner_id`` nor ``owner_address`` are set.
params.owner_address: For `NFTs on the TON blockchain <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#withdraw-a-collectible-gift-to-the-ton-blockchain>`_, contains the address of the owner (append it to the `ton_blockchain_explorer_url client configuration value » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#ton-blockchain-explorer-url>`_ to obtain a link with information about the address).
params.availability_issued: Total number of gifts of the same type that were upgraded to a collectible gift.
params.availability_total: Total number of gifts of the same type that can be upgraded or were already upgraded to a collectible gift.
params.gift_address: For `NFTs on the TON blockchain <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#withdraw-a-collectible-gift-to-the-ton-blockchain>`_, contains the address of the NFT (append it to the `ton_blockchain_explorer_url client configuration value » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#ton-blockchain-explorer-url>`_ to obtain a link with information about the address).
params.released_by: This gift was released by the specified peer.
params.value_currency: Currency for the gift's estimated price.
params.value_usd_amount: Estimated price of the gift in USD cents.
params.theme_peer: The current chat where the associated `chat theme <https://core.telegram.org/api/themes#chat-themes>`_ is installed, if any (gift-based themes can only be installed in one chat at a time).
params.host_id: If set, the gift is currently `hosted on the specified user or channel profile » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#hosted-collectible-gifts>`_, while ownership remains with the TON wallet in ``owner_address``.
params.offer_min_stars: If set, you can `send a purchase offer for this gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gift-purchase-offers>`_: the minimum offer price is specified in this flag.
params.craft_chance_permille: Success probability, per 1000, contributed by this gift when it is used for `crafting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`_.

StarGift.desc: Represents a `star gift, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ for more info.

params.limited: Whether this is a limited-supply gift.
params.sold_out: Whether this gift sold out and cannot be bought anymore.
params.birthday: Whether this is a birthday-themed gift
params.require_premium: This gift can only be bought by users with a `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ subscription.
params.limited_per_user: If set, the maximum number of gifts of this type that can be owned by a single user is limited and specified in ``per_user_total``, and the remaining slots for the current user in ``per_user_remains``.
params.peer_color_available: If set, collectible gifts of this type may be used to generate a `message color palette and pattern » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors#collectible-message-palettes>`_.
params.auction: If set, this is a collectible gift that can only be bought through a `collectible gift auction » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_.
params.stars: Price of the gift in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_.
params.availability_remains: For limited-supply gifts: the remaining number of gifts that may be bought.
params.availability_total: For limited-supply gifts: the total number of gifts that was available in the initial supply.
params.availability_resale: The total number of (upgraded to `collectibles <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ ) gifts of this type currently on `resale <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`_
params.convert_stars: The receiver of this gift may convert it to this many Telegram Stars, instead of displaying it on their profile page. ``convert_stars`` will be equal to ``stars`` only if the gift was bought using recently bought Telegram Stars, otherwise it will be less than ``stars``.
params.first_sale_date: For sold out gifts only: when was the gift first bought.
params.last_sale_date: For sold out gifts only: when was the gift last bought.
params.upgrade_stars: The number of Telegram Stars the user can pay to `convert the gift into a collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.
params.resell_min_stars: The minimum price in `Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ for gifts of this type currently on `resale <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`_.
params.title: Title of the gift
params.released_by: This gift was released by the specified peer.
params.per_user_total: Maximum number of gifts of this type that can be owned by any user.
params.per_user_remains: Remaining number of gifts of this type that can be owned by the current user.
params.locked_until_date: If set, the specified gift *possibly* cannot be sent until the specified date, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ for the full flow.
params.auction_slug: Always set for gifts that can be bought on `auctions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_, contains the `auction deep link slug » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#auction-links>`_.
params.gifts_per_round: Always set for gifts that can be bought on `auctions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_, contains the number of gifts of this kind that are distributed on every round.
params.auction_start_date: Always set for gifts that can be bought on `auctions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_, contains the UNIX timestamp indicating when will the auction start (or when the auction started, if it points to the past).
params.upgrade_variants: Total number of possible `collectible variants » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#listing-all-possible-collectible-variants>`_ for this gift type.
params.background: Default background palette for this gift type, used when rendering gift cards and previews before a specific collectible backdrop is chosen.

bots.PreviewInfo.desc: Contains info about `Main Mini App previews, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps#main-mini-app-previews>`_ for more info.

params.media: All preview medias for the language code passed to `bots.getPreviewInfo <https://core.telegram.org/method/bots.getPreviewInfo>`_.
params.lang_codes: All available language codes for which preview medias were uploaded (regardless of the language code passed to `bots.getPreviewInfo <https://core.telegram.org/method/bots.getPreviewInfo>`_ ).

payments.StarsRevenueWithdrawalUrl.desc: Contains the URL to use to `withdraw Telegram Star revenue <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#withdrawing-revenue>`_.

params.url: Contains the URL to use to `withdraw Telegram Star revenue <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#withdrawing-revenue>`_.

bots.PopularAppBots.desc: Popular `Main Mini Apps <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps#main-mini-apps>`_, to be used in the `apps tab of global search » <https://core.telegram.org/api/search#apps-tab>`_.

params.users: The bots associated to each `Main Mini App, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps#main-mini-apps>`_ for more info.

params.crafted: This model is reserved for `crafting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`_, and should be filtered out from regular upgrade previews.
params.name: Name of the model

params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_

messages.FoundStickersNotModified.desc: No new stickers were found for the specified query

StarsTonAmount.desc: Describes an amount of Gram in nanograms (i.e. ``1/1_000_000_000`` of a Gram).

params.amount: The amount in nanograms.

ReportResultAddComment.desc: The user should enter an additional comment for the moderators, and then `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`_ must be re-invoked, passing the comment to `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`_. ``message``.

params.optional: Whether this step can be skipped by the user, passing an empty ``message`` to `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`_, or if a non-empty ``message`` is mandatory.
params.option: The `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`_ method must be re-invoked, passing this option to ``option``

ReportResultChooseOption.desc: The user must choose one of the following options, and then `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`_ must be re-invoked, passing the option's ``option`` identifier to `messages.report <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.report>`_. ``option``.

params.title: Title of the option popup
params.options: Available options, rendered as menu entries.

StarsGiveawayWinnersOption.desc: Allowed options for the number of giveaway winners.

params.default: If set, this option must be pre-selected by default in the option list.
params.users: The number of users that will be randomly chosen as winners.
params.per_user_stars: The number of `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ each winner will receive.

PaidReactionPrivacyPeer.desc: Send paid reactions as the specified peer, fetched using `channels.getSendAs <https://core.telegram.org/method/channels.getSendAs>`_ with the ``for_paid_reactions`` flag set.

params.peer: The peer to send reactions as.

StarGiftAttributeOriginalDetails.desc: Info about the sender, receiver and message attached to the original `gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_, before it was upgraded to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.

params.sender_id: Original sender of the gift, absent if the gift was private.
params.message: Original message attached to the gift, if present.

StarRefProgram.desc: Info about an `affiliate program offered by a bot <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`_

params.bot_id: ID of the bot that offers the program
params.commission_permille: An affiliate gets a commission of `starRefProgram <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starRefProgram>`_. ``commission_permille`` ‰ `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ for every mini app transaction made by users they refer
params.duration_months: An affiliate gets a commission for every mini app transaction made by users they refer, for ``duration_months`` months after a referral link is imported, starting the bot for the first time
params.end_date: Point in time (Unix timestamp) when the affiliate program will be closed (optional, if not set the affiliate program isn't scheduled to be closed)
params.daily_revenue_per_user: The amount of daily revenue per user in Telegram Stars of the bot that created the affiliate program. To obtain the approximated revenue per referred user, multiply this value by ``commission_permille`` and divide by ``1000``.

users.UsersSlice.desc: Describes a partial list of users.

params.count: Total number of users (bigger than the users specified in ``users`` )

StarsAmount.desc: Describes a real (i.e. possibly decimal) amount of `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_.

params.amount: The integer amount of Telegram Stars.
params.nanos: The decimal amount of Telegram Stars, expressed as nanostars (i.e. 1 nanostar is equal to ``1/1_000_000_000`` th (one billionth) of a Telegram Star). This field may also be negative (the allowed range is from ``-999_999_999`` to ``999_999_999`` ).

ConnectedBotStarRef.desc: Info about an `active affiliate program we have with a Mini App <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals#becoming-an-affiliate>`_

params.revoked: If set, this affiliation was revoked by the affiliate using `payments.editConnectedStarRefBot <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.editConnectedStarRefBot>`_, or by the affiliation program owner using `bots.updateStarRefProgram <https://core.telegram.org/method/bots.updateStarRefProgram>`_
params.bot_id: ID of the mini app that created the affiliate program
params.commission_permille: The number of Telegram Stars received by the affiliate for each 1000 Telegram Stars received by ``bot_id``
params.duration_months: Number of months the program will be active; if not set, there is no expiration date.
params.participants: The number of users that used the affiliate program
params.revenue: The number of Telegram Stars that were earned by the affiliate program

InputSavedStarGiftUser.desc: A gift received in a private chat with another user.

params.msg_id: ID of the `messageService <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageService>`_ with the `messageActionStarGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionStarGift>`_ with the gift.

params.count: Total number of results (can be less than the returned ``gifts``, in which case ``next_offset`` will be set).
params.chat_notifications_enabled: Ternary value: can be not set, set&true, set&false. Can only be set for channels we own: the value indicates whether we `enabled gift notifications <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#notifications-for-received-channel-gifts>`_ for this channel.
params.next_offset: Offset to pass to `payments.getSavedStarGifts <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getSavedStarGifts>`_ to fetch the next page of results.

params.chats: Info about sponsored chats and channels

SavedStarGift.desc: Represents a `gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ owned by a peer.

params.name_hidden: If set, the gift sender in ``from_id`` and the ``message`` are set only for the receiver of the gift.
params.unsaved: If set, the gift is **not** pinned on the user's profile.
params.refunded: This gift was upgraded to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ and then re-downgraded to a regular gift because a request to refund the payment related to the upgrade was made, and the money was returned.
params.can_upgrade: Only set for non-collectible gifts, if they can be upgraded to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.
params.pinned_to_top: Whether this gift is pinned on top of the user's profile page.
params.upgrade_separate: If set, someone already `separately pre-paid <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#prepaying-for-someone-elses-upgrade>`_ for the upgrade of this gift.
params.from_id: Sender of the gift (unset for anonymous gifts).
params.msg_id: For gifts received by users, ID to use in `inputSavedStarGiftUser <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputSavedStarGiftUser>`_ constructors.
params.saved_id: For gifts received by channels, ID to use in `inputSavedStarGiftChat <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputSavedStarGiftChat>`_ constructors.
params.convert_stars: For non-collectible gifts, the receiver of this gift may convert it to this many Telegram Stars, instead of displaying it on their profile page.
params.upgrade_stars: **Only** for **pre-paid** non-collectible gifts, the number of Telegram Stars the sender has **already paid** to `convert the gift into a collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ (this is different from the meaning of the flag in `messageActionStarGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionStarGift>`_, where it signals the upgrade price for not yet upgraded gifts).
params.can_export_at: If set, indicates that the current gift can't be `exported to the TON blockchain » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#withdraw-a-collectible-gift-to-the-ton-blockchain>`_ yet: the owner will be able to export it at the specified unixtime.
params.transfer_stars: If set, indicates that the gift can be `transferred » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#transferring-collectible-gifts>`_ to another user by paying the specified amount of stars.
params.can_transfer_at: If set, indicates that the current gift can't be `transferred » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#transferring-collectible-gifts>`_ yet: the owner will be able to transfer it at the specified unixtime.
params.can_resell_at: If set, indicates that the current gift can't be `resold » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`_ yet: the owner will be able to put it up for sale at the specified unixtime.
params.collection_id: IDs of the `collections » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#gift-collections>`_ that this gift is a part of.
params.prepaid_upgrade_hash: `Hash to prepay for a gift upgrade separately » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#prepaying-for-someone-elses-upgrade>`_.
params.drop_original_details_stars: If set, the `starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails>`_ attribute of this gift may be removed by paying the specified amount of stars, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#dropping-the-original-details-of-an-upgraded-gift>`_ for the full flow.
params.gift_num: Collectible number assigned to the gift, if already known.
params.can_craft_at: If set, this gift can be used for `crafting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`_ only starting from the specified unixtime.

params.placeholder_path: SVG placeholder logo, compressed using the same format used for `vector thumbnails » <https://core.telegram.org/api/files#vector-thumbnails>`_.

messages.PreparedInlineMessage.desc: Represents a `prepared inline message received via a bot's mini app, that can be sent to some chats » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/inline#21-using-a-prepared-inline-message>`_

params.result: The contents of the message, to be shown in a preview
params.peer_types: Types of chats where this message can be sent

account.PaidMessagesRevenue.desc: Total number of non-refunded `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ a user has spent on sending us messages either directly or through a channel, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`_ for more info on paid messages.

payments.SuggestedStarRefBots.desc: A list of suggested `mini apps <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps>`_ with available `affiliate programs <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`_

params.count: Total number of results (for pagination)
params.suggested_bots: Suggested affiliate programs (full or partial list to be fetched using pagination)

InputSavedStarGiftSlug.desc: Points to a `collectible gift obtained from a collectible gift link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#collectible-gift-link>`_.

params.slug: Slug from the link.

params.name: Name of the backdrop
params.center_color: Color of the center of the backdrop in RGB24 format.
params.edge_color: Color of the edges of the backdrop in RGB24 format.
params.pattern_color: Color of the `starGiftAttributePattern <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributePattern>`_ applied on the backdrop in RGB24 format.
params.text_color: Color of the text on the backdrop in RGB24 format.

InputSavedStarGiftChat.desc: A gift received by a channel we own.

params.saved_id: ID of the gift, must be the ``saved_id`` of a `messageActionStarGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionStarGift>`_ / `messageActionStarGiftUnique <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionStarGiftUnique>`_ constructor.

params.can_modify_custom_description: Indicates whether the bot is allowed to set a custom description field for individual verified peers, different from the ``custom_description`` provided here.
params.company: The name of the organization that provides the verification
params.custom_description: An optional default description for the verification

params.count: Total number of results.
params.gifts: Collectible gifts on resale (may be less than ``count``, in which case ``next_offset`` will be set).
params.next_offset: Offset for pagination, pass this to `payments.getResaleStarGifts <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getResaleStarGifts>`_. ``offset`` to fetch the next results.
params.attributes: Possible gift attributes, only set if `payments.getResaleStarGifts <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getResaleStarGifts>`_. ``attributes_hash`` is set (on the first call, it must be equal to ``0`` ).
params.attributes_hash: Hash of the ``attributes`` field, pass this to `payments.getResaleStarGifts <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getResaleStarGifts>`_. ``attributes_hash`` to avoid returning any attributes (flag not set) if they haven't changed.
params.counters: Indicates the total number of gifts that have a specific attribute, only set if `payments.getResaleStarGifts <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getResaleStarGifts>`_. ``offset`` is empty (since this field is not related to the current result page but to all of them, it's only returned on the first page).

params.media: The `messageMediaWebPage <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageMediaWebPage>`_ or a `messageMediaEmpty <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageMediaEmpty>`_ if there is no preview.

stories.CanSendStoryCount.desc: Contains the number of available active story slots (equal to the value of the `story_expiring_limit_* client configuration parameter <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#story-expiring-limit-default>`_ minus the number of currently active stories).

payments.StarGiftWithdrawalUrl.desc: A URL that can be used to import the exported NFT on Fragment.

payments.StarGiftCollections.desc: Represents a list of `star gift collections » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#gift-collections>`_.

params.random_id: ID of the sponsored peer, to be passed to `messages.viewSponsoredMessage <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.viewSponsoredMessage>`_, `messages.clickSponsoredMessage <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.clickSponsoredMessage>`_ or `messages.reportSponsoredMessage <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.reportSponsoredMessage>`_ (the same methods used for `sponsored messages &raquo <https://core.telegram.org/api/sponsored-messages>`_ ). See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates#updatemessageid-updates>`_ for more info on random ID deduplication and updateMessageID mapping.
params.sponsor_info: If set, contains additional information about the sponsor to be shown along with the peer.
params.additional_info: If set, contains additional information about the sponsored message to be shown along with the peer.

StarGiftAttributeIdBackdrop.desc: The ID of a backdrop of a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.

RequirementToContactEmpty.desc: This user can be freely contacted.

PaidReactionPrivacyDefault.desc: Uses the default reaction privacy, set using `messages.togglePaidReactionPrivacy <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.togglePaidReactionPrivacy>`_.

payments.StarGiftUpgradePreview.desc: A preview of the possible attributes (chosen randomly) a `gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ can receive after upgrading it to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ for more info.

params.prices: Contains a similar list of upgrade prices and timestamps, not as granular as in ``next_prices`` (i.e. prices are approximately 1 month apart), to be used mainly to scale the price graph, and to show a more general future overview of the upgrade price.
params.next_prices: Contains the current upgrade price and a list of future prices, each associated to a UNIX timestamp that indicates when the price comes in effect (the current price is valid only until the next one comes into effect, and so on for all prices in the list).

params.suggestion: The suggestion ID, can be passed to `help.dismissSuggestion <https://core.telegram.org/method/help.dismissSuggestion>`_.
params.title: Title of the suggestion.
params.url: URL to open when the user clicks on the suggestion.

RequirementToContactPremium.desc: This user requires us to buy a `Premium <https://core.telegram.org/api/premium>`_ subscription in order to contact them.

RequirementToContactPaidMessages.desc: This user requires us to pay the specified amount of `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ to send them a message, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`_ for the full flow.

SearchPostsFlood.desc: Indicates if the specified `global post search » <https://core.telegram.org/api/search#posts-tab>`_ requires payment.

params.query_is_free: The specified query is free (and it **will not use up free search slots** ).
params.total_daily: Total number of daily free search slots.
params.remains: Remaining number of free search slots.
params.wait_till: If there are no more search slots, specifies the unixtime when more search slots will be available.
params.stars_amount: The number of `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ to pay for each non-free search.

params.title: Title of the collection.
params.icon: Optional icon for the collection, taken from the first gift in the collection.
params.gifts_count: Number of gifts in the collection.
params.hash: Field to use **instead of ``collection_id``** when generating the hash to pass to `payments.getStarGiftCollections <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getStarGiftCollections>`_.

users.Users.desc: Describes a list of users (or bots).

params.id: ID of the item, a positive (non-zero) integer unique within the current list.
params.title: Text of the item, maximum length equal to `todo_item_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#todo-item-length-max>`_.

params.others_can_append: If set, users different from the creator of the list can append items to the list.
params.others_can_complete: If set, users different from the creator of the list can complete items in the list.
params.title: Title of the todo list, maximum length equal to `todo_title_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#todo-title-length-max>`_.

StarsRating.desc: Represents the profile's `star rating, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#star-rating>`_ for more info.

params.level: The current level, may be negative.
params.current_level_stars: The numerical value of the rating required for the current level.
params.stars: Numerical value of the current rating.
params.next_level_stars: The numerical value of the rating required for the next level.

StarGiftAttributeIdModel.desc: The ID of a model of a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.

params.title: Name of the album.
params.icon_photo: Photo from the first story of the album, if it's a photo.
params.icon_video: Video from the first story of the album, if it's a video.

ProfileTabPosts.desc: Represents the `stories <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_ tab of a profile page.

StarGiftAttributeCounter.desc: Indicates the total number of gifts that have the specified attribute.

params.attribute: The attribute (just the ID, without the attribute itself).
params.count: Total number of gifts with this attribute.

params.hash: Hash to pass to `stories.getAlbums <https://core.telegram.org/method/stories.getAlbums>`_ to avoid returning any results if they haven't changed.

contacts.SponsoredPeersEmpty.desc: There are no sponsored peers for this query.

params.accepted: Whether the suggested post was accepted.
params.rejected: Whether the suggested post was rejected.

StarGiftAttributeIdPattern.desc: The ID of a pattern of a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.

params.id: The ID of the completed item.
params.completed_by: ID of the user that completed the item.

payments.UniqueStarGiftValueInfo.desc: Information about the value of a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.

params.last_sale_on_fragment: If set, the last sale was completed on Fragment.
params.value_is_average: If set, the ``value`` is calculated from the average value of sold gifts of the same type. Otherwise, it is based on the sale price of the gift.
params.currency: Three-letter ISO 4217 `currency <https://core.telegram.org/bots/payments#supported-currencies>`_ code (a localized fiat currency used to represent prices and price estimations in this constructor).
params.value: Estimated value of the gift, in the smallest unit of the currency specified in ``currency``.
params.initial_sale_date: Initial purchase date of the gift.
params.initial_sale_price: Initial purchase price in the smallest unit of the currency specified in ``currency`` (automatically converted from ``initial_sale_stars`` ).
params.last_sale_date: Last resale date of the gift.
params.last_sale_price: Last resale price, in the smallest unit of the currency specified in ``currency``.
params.floor_price: The current minimum price of collectible gifts of the same type, in the smallest unit of the currency specified in ``currency``.
params.average_price: The current average sale price of collectible gifts of the same type, in the smallest unit of the currency specified in ``currency``.
params.listed_count: Number of gifts of the same type currently being resold on Telegram.
params.fragment_listed_count: Number of gifts of the same type currently being resold on fragment.
params.fragment_listed_url: Fragment link to the listing of gifts of the same type currently being resold on fragment.

ProfileTabVoice.desc: Represents the voice messages tab of a profile page.

DisallowedGiftsSettings.desc: Disallow the reception of specific `gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ types.

params.disallow_unlimited_stargifts: Disallow the reception of gifts with an unlimited supply (those with the `starGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGift>`_. ``limited`` flag **not** set).
params.disallow_limited_stargifts: Disallow the reception of limited-supply gifts (those with the `starGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGift>`_. ``limited`` flag set).
params.disallow_premium_gifts: Disallow the reception of `gifted Telegram Premium subscriptions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.
params.disallow_stargifts_from_channels: Disallow the reception of gifts sent by channels.

ProfileTabMusic.desc: Represents the `music <https://core.telegram.org/api/profile#music>`_ tab of a profile page.

ProfileTabMedia.desc: Represents the media tab of a profile page.

ProfileTabGifts.desc: Represents the `gifts <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ tab of a profile page.

users.SavedMusicNotModified.desc: This subset of the songs currently pinned on a user's profile hasn't changed, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/profile#music>`_ for more info.

params.count: Total number of songs on the user's profile.

ProfileTabFiles.desc: Represents the shared files tab of a profile.

InputChatTheme.desc: Set an emoji-based chat theme, returned by `account.getChatThemes <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.getChatThemes>`_.

params.reply: Whether the bot can send and edit messages in private chats that had incoming messages in the last 24 hours.
params.read_messages: Whether the bot can mark incoming private messages as read.
params.delete_sent_messages: Whether the bot can delete messages sent by the bot.
params.delete_received_messages: Whether the bot can delete received private messages in managed chats.
params.edit_name: Whether the bot can edit the first and last name of the business account.
params.edit_bio: Whether the bot can edit the bio of the business account.
params.edit_profile_photo: Whether the bot can edit the profile photo of the business account.
params.edit_username: Whether the bot can edit the username of the business account.
params.view_gifts: Whether the bot can view gifts and the amount of Telegram Stars owned by the business account.
params.sell_gifts: Whether the bot can convert regular gifts owned by the business account to Telegram Stars.
params.change_gift_settings: Whether the bot can change the privacy settings pertaining to gifts for the business account.
params.transfer_and_upgrade_gifts: Whether the bot can transfer and upgrade gifts owned by the business account.
params.transfer_stars: Whether the bot can transfer Telegram Stars received by the business account to its own account, or use them to upgrade and transfer gifts.
params.manage_stories: Whether the bot can post, edit and delete stories on behalf of the business account.

payments.StarGiftCollectionsNotModified.desc: The list of `star gift collections » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#gift-collections>`_ hasn't changed.

params.amount: Amount of the bid in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_.
params.date: Date when the bid was placed.

params.gift: The gift currently being distributed in the auction.
params.user_state: Auction state related to the current user (i.e. info about placed bids, won gifts, and so on).
params.timeout: Re-invoke the `payments.getStarGiftAuctionState <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getStarGiftAuctionState>`_ method after ``timeout`` seconds to keep receiving auction updates, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_ for more info on the full flow.

payments.CheckCanSendGiftResultOk.desc: The specified gift can be sent.

GroupCallDonor.desc: Describes a live story donor in the `donation leaderboard » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#paid-live-story-donations>`_.

params.top: Whether this donor is included in the top-donor leaderboard
params.my: Whether this entry describes the current user's donations
params.stars: Total Stars donated by this donor

phone.GroupCallStars.desc: Contains a live story's total donations and top donors, see `paid live story donations » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#paid-live-story-donations>`_.

params.total_stars: Total Stars donated to the live story

users.SavedMusic.desc: List of songs currently pinned on a user's profile, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/profile#music>`_ for more info.

params.count: Total number of songs (can be bigger than ``documents`` depending on the passed ``limit``, and the default maximum ``limit`` in which case pagination is required).

ProfileTabLinks.desc: Represents the shared links tab of a profile page.

account.SavedMusicIdsNotModified.desc: The list of IDs of songs ( `document <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/document>`_. ``id`` s) currently pinned on our profile hasn't changed.

ProfileTabGifs.desc: Represents the gifs tab of a profile page.

StarGiftUpgradePrice.desc: Indicates the price for a `gift upgrade » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ starting from a specific point in time.

params.date: UNIX timestamp indicating when the price will be in effect.

params.start_date: UNIX timestamp indicating when the auction started.
params.end_date: UNIX timestamp indicating when the auction ended.
params.listed_count: Number of gifts from the auction currently being resold on Telegram: if set, when the corresponding element is clicked in graphical clients, `payments.getResaleStarGifts <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.getResaleStarGifts>`_ should be invoked with the ID of the gift associated to this auction, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_ for more info.
params.fragment_listed_count: Number of gifts from the auction currently being resold on `Fragment <https://fragment.com>`_.
params.fragment_listed_url: Only set if ``fragment_listed_count`` is set. If set, when the corresponding element is clicked in graphical clients, this URL should be opened.

StarGiftAuctionStateNotModified.desc: Returned only by auction methods (never by updates) if the passed ``version`` is equal to the remote `auction » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_. ``version``, meaning auction information hasn't changed over the locally cached version.

payments.StarGiftActiveAuctionsNotModifi.desc: The list of currently active `gift auctions <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_ **where the user has placed a bid** hasn't changed.

StarGiftAuctionUserState.desc: Contains information about the current user's state in an `auction » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_.

params.returned: If set, the placed bid was returned to the user, because it was outbid so much that it fell out of the top `starGiftAuctionState <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAuctionState>`_. ``gifts_left`` positions, meaning that even if no new bids are placed, the user will never receive any gifts, so the bid was completely removed from the auction, and in order to participate again the user must manually make a new bid.
params.bid_amount: Contains the amount of the placed bid in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_.
params.bid_date: Contains a UNIX timestamp, indicating when the bid was placed.
params.min_bid_amount: Contains the minumum allowed bid amount in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_, if set overrides `starGiftAuctionState <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAuctionState>`_. ``min_bid_amount`` for the current user.
params.bid_peer: Contains the peer that will receive the gift, if you end up winning this round
params.acquired_count: Contains the number of gifts that were purchased so far in the auction by the current user.

StarGiftAuctionAcquiredGift.desc: Describes a gift that the current user won in an auction.

params.name_hidden: If set, your name will be hidden if the destination peer decides to display the gift on their profile (they will still see that you sent the gift).
params.peer: The peer that received the gift.
params.bid_amount: The amount in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ that was bid in order to obtain the gift.
params.round: The round number where the gift was obtained.
params.pos: The position of the gift in the auction.
params.message: Optional message that attached with the gift, passed when making the bid.
params.gift_num: If set, the collectible number of the won gift among all collectibles of the same type. This field is optional because **only** auction collectibles won before this field was introduced in the API will not have this flag set.

payments.StarGiftAuctionAcquiredGifts.desc: Describes all the gifts that the current user won in an `auction <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_.

GroupCallMessage.desc: Represents an `in-call message » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#in-call-messages>`_, emoji reaction, paid live story comment or standalone paid live story donation.

params.from_admin: Whether the message was sent by a group call admin
params.message: Message text or emoji reaction; empty for standalone paid live story donations. Must be at most `group_call_message_length_limit » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#group-call-message-length-limit>`_ UTF-8 characters long. For paid chats, use `stars_groupcall_message_limits » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#stars-groupcall-message-limits>`_ to source limits according to the passed value of ``paid_message_stars``, instead.
params.paid_message_stars: Number of Telegram Stars donated with the message or standalone donation

RecentStory.desc: Summary of a peer's `active stories » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#recent-story-summaries>`_, embedded in `user <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/user>`_. ``stories_max_id`` and `channel <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/channel>`_. ``stories_max_id`` and returned by `stories.getPeerMaxIDs <https://core.telegram.org/method/stories.getPeerMaxIDs>`_.

params.live: Whether the peer is currently broadcasting a `live story » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#live-stories>`_.
params.max_id: If ``live`` is set, ID of the peer's active `live story » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#live-stories>`_; otherwise, ID of the peer's maximum active story.

InputStarGiftAuction.desc: Used to fetch `auctions <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_ using the ID of the linked `collectible gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.

InputStarGiftAuctionSlug.desc: Used to fetch `auctions <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_ using the `slug of an auction deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#auction-links>`_.

params.slug: `Auction deep link slug » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#auction-links>`_.

account.Passkeys.desc: List of `passkeys » <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#list-passkeys>`_ associated to the current account.

params.passkeys: List of passkeys that can be used to log into the current account

params.version: Only apply incoming `starGiftAuctionState <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAuctionState>`_ constructors if the received ``version`` is bigger than the locally cached ``version``.
params.start_date: UNIX timestamp indicating when the auction will start (or when it started, if it's in the past).
params.end_date: UNIX timestamp indicating when the auction will end
params.min_bid_amount: Minumum allowed bid amount in `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_: only applicable if the user hasn't made a bid yet, otherwise must be overridden to the value of `starGiftAuctionUserState <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAuctionUserState>`_. ``min_bid_amount`` (which will be set if and only if the user already made a bid to this auction).
params.bid_levels: Contains a sparse list of bids starting from the top bids, a more detailed description is available in `the docs <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_.
params.top_bidders: User IDs of the top 3 bidders (the `user <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/user>`_ constructors will be returned as `min <https://core.telegram.org/api/min>`_ constructors in the containing object).
params.next_round_at: UNIX timestamp indicating when the current auction round will end, distributing `starGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGift>`_. ``gifts_per_round`` gifts to the top `starGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGift>`_. ``gifts_per_round`` bidders.
params.last_gift_num: The number of gifts that were distributed in the previous round (also used to compute the approximated index of the gift that the current user will receive, ``last_gift_num + approx_pos``, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_ for more info).
params.gifts_left: The remaining number of gifts that are yet to be distributed.
params.total_rounds: The total number of rounds in this auction.

StarGiftActiveAuctionState.desc: Contains info about `an auction where the user has placed a bid » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_.

params.gift: The `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ currently being distributed in the auction.
params.user_state: Auction state related to the current user (i.e. info about placed bids, won gifts and so on).

StarGiftAuctionRoundExtendable.desc: Describes one or more extendable `collectible gift auction rounds » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_.

params.num: This object describes all rounds starting from ``num`` up until ``next.num-1`` inclusively ( ``next`` is the next `StarGiftAuctionRound <https://core.telegram.org/type/StarGiftAuctionRound>`_ ).
params.duration: Duration in seconds of the round(s).
params.extend_top: The round(s) will be extended by ``extend_window`` if a bid changes the composition/order of the top ``extend_top`` bidders.
params.extend_window: The round(s) will be extended by this many seconds if a bid changes the composition/order of the top ``extend_top`` bidders.

Passkey.desc: Human-readable info about a passkey associated to an account, returned when `creating a passkey » <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#creating-a-passkey>`_ or `listing passkeys » <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#list-passkeys>`_.

params.id: Unique passkey ID, usable for example in `account.deletePasskey <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.deletePasskey>`_.
params.name: Human-readable passkey name
params.software_emoji_id: ID of the `custom emoji <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ used as icon for the software or password manager that created the passkey
params.last_usage_date: Date when the passkey was last used to log in

InputChatThemeUniqueGift.desc: Set a theme based on an owned or `hosted collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#hosted-collectible-gifts>`_, returned by `account.getUniqueGiftChatThemes <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.getUniqueGiftChatThemes>`_.

params.slug: The slug from `starGiftUnique <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftUnique>`_. ``slug``.

StarGiftAttributeRarityUncommon.desc: Represents uncommon collectible gift attribute rarity.

account.SavedMusicIds.desc: List of IDs of songs ( `document <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/document>`_. ``id`` s) currently pinned on our profile, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/profile#music>`_ for more info.

InputPasskeyCredentialFirebasePNV.desc: Alternative `passkey <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys>`_ credential that proves ownership of the account's phone number through a Firebase Phone Number Verification (PNV) token, used on official apps where a full WebAuthn `public-key passkey <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPasskeyCredentialPublicKey>`_ cannot be created, in a way similar to `Firebase SMS authentication » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auth>`_.

params.pnv_token: Firebase Phone Number Verification token attesting that the user controls the phone number associated with the account.

StarGiftAttributeRarity.desc: Exact rarity value for a collectible gift attribute.

params.permille: Probability of this attribute, in permille

auth.PasskeyLoginOptions.desc: Passkey login options, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#logging-in-with-a-passkey>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.options: JSON-encoded object whose ``publicKey`` field contains a `PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions>`_ object.

StarGiftAttributeRarityRare.desc: Represents rare collectible gift attribute rarity.

account.PasskeyRegistrationOptions.desc: Passkey registration options, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#creating-a-passkey>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.options: JSON-encoded object whose ``publicKey`` field contains a `PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions>`_ object.

StarGiftAuctionRound.desc: Describes one or more `collectible gift auction rounds » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_.

params.num: This object describes all rounds starting from ``num`` up until ``next.num-1`` inclusively ( ``next`` is the next `StarGiftAuctionRound <https://core.telegram.org/type/StarGiftAuctionRound>`_ ).
params.duration: Duration in seconds of the round(s).

InputAiComposeToneID.desc: References a custom `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_ by its ID and access hash.

KeyboardButtonStyle.desc: This constructor allows setting a custom background color and custom emoji label for a button, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/buttons#button-styles>`_ for more info.

params.bg_primary: A dark blue color, recommended for main actions.
params.bg_danger: A red color, recommended for destructive actions.
params.bg_success: A green color, recommended for positive actions.
params.icon: The ID of a `custom emoji <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ to be displayed before the button's label.

InputPasskeyResponseRegister.desc: WebAuthn registration response used when registering a new passkey, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#creating-a-passkey>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.client_data: Base64url-decoded ``clientDataJSON`` field of an `AuthenticatorAttestationResponse <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AuthenticatorAttestationResponse>`_, wrapped in `dataJSON <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/dataJSON>`_

payments.StarGiftUpgradeAttributes.desc: List of just the collectible attributes that may appear for a gift type once it's upgraded to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.

params.attributes: Full list of possible attributes that may be assigned when gifts of the specified type are turned into `collectible gifts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_, including craft-only models marked with `starGiftAttributeModel <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeModel>`_. ``crafted``.

InputAiComposeToneSlug.desc: References a custom `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_ by its public slug, used when opening an `AI compose tone link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#ai-compose-tone-links>`_.

params.slug: Public tone slug, as returned in `aiComposeTone <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/aiComposeTone>`_. ``slug``

aicompose.TonesNotModified.desc: The list of saved `AI composer tones » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_ hasn't changed since the last time it was fetched (i.e. the ``hash`` passed to `aicompose.getTones <https://core.telegram.org/method/aicompose.getTones>`_ is still valid).

StarGiftAttributeRarityLegendary.desc: Represents legendary collectible gift attribute rarity.

payments.StarGiftActiveAuctions.desc: Describes all currently active `gift auctions <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_ **where the user has placed a bid**.

params.auctions: Auctions where the user has placed a bid

InputPasskeyResponseLogin.desc: WebAuthn authentication response used when logging in with a passkey, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#logging-in-with-a-passkey>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.client_data: Base64url-decoded ``clientDataJSON`` field of an `AuthenticatorAssertionResponse <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AuthenticatorAssertionResponse>`_, wrapped in `dataJSON <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/dataJSON>`_
params.user_handle: Base64url-decoded ``userHandle`` field of an `AuthenticatorAssertionResponse <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/AuthenticatorAssertionResponse>`_. The user handle specified by the server is in ``<dc_id>:<user_id>`` format.

AiComposeToneExample.desc: An example showing how an `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_ rephrases a message, used as a preview in the tone picker.

params.to: The same sample message after being rephrased with this tone

stats.PollStats.desc: `Statistics <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats#poll-statistics>`_ for a poll sent in a message.

params.votes_graph: A graph containing the number of votes cast in the poll over time

bots.RequestedButton.desc: Contains the request ID a bot should pass to a `Mini App <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps>`_ after preparing a peer request button with `bots.requestWebViewButton <https://core.telegram.org/method/bots.requestWebViewButton>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/buttons#requesting-peers-via-mini-apps>`_ for more info.

params.webapp_req_id: Mini App request ID, to be passed by the bot to the Mini App and then back to `bots.getRequestedWebViewButton <https://core.telegram.org/method/bots.getRequestedWebViewButton>`_ and `messages.sendBotRequestedPeer <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.sendBotRequestedPeer>`_

bots.AccessSettings.desc: Access restriction settings for a `managed bot » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/managed-bots#managing-a-managed-bot>`_.

params.restricted: If set, only the owner and the users in ``add_users`` can access the managed bot
params.add_users: Additional users (max 10, excluding the owner) who can access the managed bot; only present when ``restricted`` is set

StarGiftBackground.desc: Contains the default background palette of a `gift type » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#listing-all-possible-collectible-variants>`_.

params.center_color: Center color of the background palette, in RGB24 format.
params.edge_color: Edge color of the background palette, in RGB24 format.
params.text_color: Text color to use on top of the background palette, in RGB24 format.

payments.CheckCanSendGiftResultFail.desc: The specified gift cannot be sent yet for the specified reason.

params.reason: The reason why it can't be sent yet.

InputPasskeyCredentialPublicKey.desc: Public-key passkey credential used both for registration and for login, see `creating a passkey » <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#creating-a-passkey>`_ and `logging in with a passkey » <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#logging-in-with-a-passkey>`_ for the full flows.

params.id: ``id`` field of a `PublicKeyCredential <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/PublicKeyCredential>`_, passed as-is without base64url-decoding when using the JSON representation
params.raw_id: ``rawId`` field of a `PublicKeyCredential <https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/PublicKeyCredential>`_, passed as-is without base64url-decoding when using the JSON representation

messages.ComposedMessageWithAI.desc: Represents a message modified by AI.

params.diff_text: If **only** the proofreading mode ( `messages.composeMessageWithAI <https://core.telegram.org/method/messages.composeMessageWithAI>`_. ``proofread`` ) is enabled, this field will be populated with a "pre-rendered" diff between the old and the new message text using **only** `diff entities » <https://core.telegram.org/api/entities#diff-entities>`_.

bots.ExportedBotToken.desc: The bot token of a `managed bot » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/managed-bots#managing-a-managed-bot>`_, exported by the manager bot.

params.token: The bot token of the managed bot

InputAiComposeToneDefault.desc: References a built-in, default `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_ by its string identifier.

params.tone: String identifier of the built-in tone, as returned in `aiComposeToneDefault <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/aiComposeToneDefault>`_. ``tone``

InputMessageReadMetric.desc: Read metric for a single message exposure, describing how long the message was visible in the chat viewport.

params.view_id: Random non-zero 64-bit ID generated for this exposure
params.time_in_view_ms: Total exposure time in milliseconds of at least one pixel of the message, after the 300 ms entry grace period
params.active_time_in_view_ms: Part of ``time_in_view_ms`` accumulated while the user is active
params.height_to_viewport_ratio_permille: ``round(max_message_height * 1000 / max_viewport_height)``, may exceed 1000 when the message is taller than the viewport

AiComposeToneDefault.desc: A built-in, default `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_, identified by a string identifier rather than by a numeric ID.

params.tone: String identifier of the built-in tone, to be passed to `inputAiComposeToneDefault <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputAiComposeToneDefault>`_
params.emoji_id: `Custom emoji ID <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ of the tone's icon
params.title: Localized, human-readable name of the tone

StarGiftAttributeRarityEpic.desc: Represents epic collectible gift attribute rarity.

AiComposeTone.desc: A custom `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_, used to rephrase messages in a specific style with the `AI message composer <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#compose-messages>`_.

params.creator: Whether the current user is the creator of this tone
params.slug: Unique tone slug, used to share and install the tone via `AI compose tone links » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#ai-compose-tone-links>`_
params.title: Human-readable tone name, up to `aicompose_tone_title_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#aicompose-tone-title-length-max>`_ UTF-8 characters long
params.emoji_id: `Custom emoji ID <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ of the tone's icon
params.prompt: The prompt that describes how the AI should rephrase messages using this tone, up to `aicompose_tone_prompt_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#aicompose-tone-prompt-length-max>`_ UTF-8 characters long; only present for tones created by the current user
params.installs_count: Number of users that have installed this tone
params.author_id: ID of the user that created this tone, if made public by the author.
params.example_english: An example showing how a sample English message is rephrased by this tone; use `aicompose.getToneExample <https://core.telegram.org/method/aicompose.getToneExample>`_ to fetch more examples.

aicompose.Tones.desc: The list of saved `AI composer tones » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_ of the current user.

params.hash: `Hash for pagination, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_
params.users: Mentioned users (i.e. the authors of the tones)

auth.CheckPassword.desc: Try logging to an account protected by a `2FA password <https://core.telegram.org/api/srp>`_.

account.UpdateUsername.desc: Changes username for the current user.

params.username: username or empty string if username is to be removedAccepted characters: a-z (case-insensitive), 0-9 and underscores.Length: 5-32 characters.

params.no_muted: Avoid receiving (silent and invisible background) notifications. Useful to save battery.
params.token_type: Device token type, see `PUSH updates <https://core.telegram.org/api/push-updates#subscribing-to-notifications>`_ for the possible values.
params.token: Device token, see `PUSH updates <https://core.telegram.org/api/push-updates#subscribing-to-notifications>`_ for the possible values.
params.app_sandbox: If `(boolTrue) <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/boolTrue>`_ is transmitted, a sandbox-certificate will be used during transmission.
params.secret: For FCM and APNS VoIP, optional encryption key used to encrypt push notifications
params.other_uids: List of user identifiers of other users currently using the client

auth.SignIn.desc: Signs in a user with a validated phone number.

params.phone_number: Phone number in the international format
params.phone_code: Valid numerical code from the SMS-message

auth.SendCode.desc: Send the verification code for login

params.settings: Settings for the code type to send

account.ReportPeer.desc: Report a peer for violation of telegram's Terms of Service

params.reason: The reason why this peer is being reported

account.DeleteAccount.desc: Delete the user's account from the telegram servers.

params.reason: Why is the account being deleted, can be empty
params.password: `2FA password <https://core.telegram.org/api/srp>`_: this field can be omitted even for accounts with 2FA enabled: in this case account account deletion will be delayed by 7 days `as specified in the docs » <https://core.telegram.org/api/account-deletion>`_

auth.AcceptLoginToken.desc: Accept QR code login token, logging in the app that generated it.

params.token: Login token embedded in QR code, for more info, see `login via QR code <https://core.telegram.org/api/qr-login>`_.

InvokeAfterMsg.desc: Invokes a query after successful completion of one of the previous queries.

params.msg_id: Message identifier on which a current query depends

account.CheckUsername.desc: Validates a username and checks availability.

params.username: usernameAccepted characters: A-z (case-insensitive), 0-9 and underscores.Length: 5-32 characters.

InvokeWithApnsSecret.desc: Official clients only, invoke with Apple push verification.

auth.CheckRecoveryPassword.desc: Check if the `2FA recovery code <https://core.telegram.org/api/srp>`_ sent using `auth.requestPasswordRecovery <https://core.telegram.org/method/auth.requestPasswordRecovery>`_ is valid, before passing it to `auth.recoverPassword <https://core.telegram.org/method/auth.recoverPassword>`_.

InvokeWithLayer.desc: Invoke the specified query using the specified API `layer <https://core.telegram.org/api/invoking#layers>`_

params.offline: If `(boolTrue) <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/boolTrue>`_ is transmitted, user status will change to `(userStatusOffline) <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/userStatusOffline>`_.

account.ChangePhone.desc: Change the phone number of the current account

params.phone_code_hash: Phone code hash received when calling `account.sendChangePhoneCode <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.sendChangePhoneCode>`_

auth.FinishPasskeyLogin.desc: Complete login with a passkey over an unauthenticated connection, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/passkeys#logging-in-with-a-passkey>`_ for more info.

params.from_dc_id: DC ID used for the initial `auth.initPasskeyLogin <https://core.telegram.org/method/auth.initPasskeyLogin>`_ request; set only if the user's DC is different from the DC used for the initial `auth.initPasskeyLogin <https://core.telegram.org/method/auth.initPasskeyLogin>`_.
params.from_auth_key_id: Auth key ID for the connection to ``from_dc_id`` (use the permanent auth key ID if PFS is enabled); set only if the user's DC is different from the DC used for the initial `auth.initPasskeyLogin <https://core.telegram.org/method/auth.initPasskeyLogin>`_.

auth.ImportWebTokenAuthorization.desc: Login by importing an authorization token

account.ResetNotifySettings.desc: Resets all notification settings from users and groups.

InvokeWithGooglePlayIntegrity.desc: Official clients only, invoke with Google Play Integrity token.

account.SetPrivacy.desc: Change privacy settings of current account

params.rules: Peers to which the privacy rule will apply.

account.UpdateNotifySettings.desc: Edits notification settings from a given user/group, from all users/all groups.

params.system_lang_code: Code for the language used on the device's OS, ISO 639-1 standard
params.lang_code: Either an ISO 639-1 language code or a language pack name obtained from a `language pack link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#language-pack-links>`_.
params.params: Additional initConnection parameters. For now, only the ``tz_offset`` field is supported, for specifying the timezone offset in seconds.

auth.RequestFirebaseSms.desc: Request an SMS code via Firebase.

params.safety_net_token: On Android, a JWS object obtained as described in the `auth documentation » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auth>`_
params.play_integrity_token: On Android, an object obtained as described in the `auth documentation » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auth>`_
params.ios_push_secret: Secret token received via an apple push notification

account.SendConfirmPhoneCode.desc: Send confirmation code to cancel account deletion, for more info `click here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/account-deletion>`_

params.hash: The hash from the service notification, for more info `click here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/account-deletion>`_

account.SendChangePhoneCode.desc: Verify a new phone number to associate to the current account

account.UnregisterDevice.desc: Deletes a device by its token, stops sending PUSH-notifications to it.

params.token_type: Device token type, see `PUSH updates <https://core.telegram.org/api/push-updates#subscribing-to-notifications>`_ for the possible values.
params.token: Device token, see `PUSH updates <https://core.telegram.org/api/push-updates#subscribing-to-notifications>`_ for the possible values.
params.other_uids: List of user identifiers of other users currently using the client

InvokeWithReCaptcha.desc: Official clients only: re-execute a method call that required reCAPTCHA verification via a ``RECAPTCHA_CHECK_%s__%s``, where the first placeholder is the ``action``, and the second one is the reCAPTCHA key ID.

account.GetBotBusinessConnection.desc:
Bots may invoke this method to re-fetch the `updateBotBusinessConnect <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updateBotBusinessConnect>`_ constructor associated with a specific `business connection_id, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_ for more info on connected business bots.
This is needed for example for freshly logged in bots that are receiving some `updateBotNewBusinessMessage <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updateBotNewBusinessMessage>`_, etc. updates because some users have already connected to the bot before it could login.
In this case, the bot is receiving messages from the business connection, but it hasn't cached the associated `updateBotBusinessConnect <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updateBotBusinessConnect>`_ with info about the connection (can it reply to messages? etc.) yet, and cannot receive the old ones because they were sent when the bot wasn't logged into the session yet.
This method can be used to fetch info about a not-yet-cached business connection, and should not be invoked if the info is already cached or to fetch changes, as eventual changes will automatically be sent as new `updateBotBusinessConnect <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updateBotBusinessConnect>`_ updates to the bot using the usual `update delivery methods » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates>`_.

Can only be **set** by monoforums, not users, i.e. ``parent_peer`` must be set if this flag is set; users must instead use the `inputPrivacyKeyNoPaidMessages <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPrivacyKeyNoPaidMessages>`_ privacy setting to remove a previously added exemption. If not set, allows the user to send us messages without paying (can be **unset** by both monoforums and users).

channels.GetAdminedPublicChannels.desc: Get `channels/supergroups/geogroups <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_ we're admin in. Usually called when the user exceeds the `limit <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/config>`_ for owned public `channels/supergroups/geogroups <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_, and the user is given the choice to remove one of his channels/supergroups/geogroups.

params.check_limit: If set and the user has reached the limit of owned public `channels/supergroups/geogroups <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_, instead of returning the channel list one of the specified `errors <https://core.telegram.org/#possible-errors>`_ will be returned.Useful to check if a new public channel can indeed be created, even before asking the user to enter a channel username to use in `channels.checkUsername <https://core.telegram.org/method/channels.checkUsername>`_ / `channels.updateUsername <https://core.telegram.org/method/channels.updateUsername>`_.
params.for_personal: Set this flag to only fetch the full list of channels that may be passed to `account.updatePersonalChannel <https://core.telegram.org/method/account.updatePersonalChannel>`_ to `display them on our profile page <https://core.telegram.org/api/profile#personal-channel>`_.

params.profiles_enabled: If set, messages from channel admins will link to their profiles, just like for group messages: can only be set if the ``signatures_enabled`` flag is set.

channels.GetAdminLog.desc: Get the admin log of a `channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_

params.admins: Only show events from these admins
params.max_id: Maximum ID of message to return (see `pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_ )
params.min_id: Minimum ID of message to return (see `pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_ )
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

channels.EditAdmin.desc: Modify the admin rights of a user in a `supergroup/channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_.

params.user_id: The ID of the user whose admin rights should be modified
params.rank: Indicates the role (rank) of the admin in the group: just an arbitrary string. If the flag is not set, the rank is left unchanged.

params.for_everyone: Whether the history should be deleted for everyone
params.max_id: ID of message **up to which** the history must be deleted

channels.SetStickers.desc: Associate a stickerset to the supergroup

channels.GetLeftChannels.desc: Get a list of `channels/supergroups <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_ we left, requires a `takeout session, see here » for more info <https://core.telegram.org/api/takeout>`_.

params.offset: Offset for `pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

channels.GetGroupsForDiscussion.desc: Get all groups that can be used as `discussion groups <https://core.telegram.org/api/discussion>`_.

channels.SetDiscussionGroup.desc: Associate a group to a channel as `discussion group <https://core.telegram.org/api/discussion>`_ for that channel

params.group: `Discussion group <https://core.telegram.org/api/discussion>`_ to associate to the channel

channels.ReadMessageContents.desc: Mark `channel/supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_ message contents as read, emitting an `updateChannelReadMessagesContents <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updateChannelReadMessagesContents>`_.

params.id: IDs of messages whose contents should be marked as read

channels.ConvertToGigagroup.desc: Convert a `supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_ to a `gigagroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_, when requested by `channel suggestions <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#channel-suggestions>`_.

channels.EditLocation.desc: Edit location of geogroup, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/nearby>`_ for more info on geogroups.

channels.ToggleSlowMode.desc: Toggle supergroup slow mode: if enabled, users will only be able to send one message every ``seconds`` seconds

params.seconds: Users will only be able to send one message every ``seconds`` seconds, ``0`` to disable the limitation

channels.TogglePreHistoryHidden.desc: Hide/unhide message history for new channel/supergroup users

channels.GetSendAs.desc: Obtains a list of peers that can be displayed as the sender in a specific context. With ``for_live_stories``, returns peers that may author `live story in-call messages » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#in-call-messages>`_.

params.for_paid_reactions: If set, fetches the list of peers that can be used to send `paid reactions <https://core.telegram.org/api/reactions#paid-reactions>`_ to messages of a specific peer.
params.for_live_stories: Fetch the peers that may be passed to `phone.sendGroupCallMessage <https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.sendGroupCallMessage>`_. ``send_as`` to comment or react in a `live story » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#in-call-messages>`_.
params.peer: The target peer; when ``for_live_stories`` is set, the peer that owns the live story.

channels.DeleteParticipantHistory.desc: Delete all messages sent by a specific participant of a given supergroup

params.participant: The participant whose messages should be deleted

params.order: The new order for active usernames. All active usernames must be specified.

channels.ToggleUsername.desc: Activate or deactivate a purchased `fragment.com <https://fragment.com>`_ username associated to a `supergroup or channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_ we own.

params.active: Whether to activate or deactivate the username

channels.ToggleAntiSpam.desc: Enable or disable the `native antispam system <https://core.telegram.org/api/antispam>`_.

params.enabled: Enable or disable the native antispam system.

channels.ToggleJoinRequest.desc: Set whether all users should `request admin approval to join the group » <https://core.telegram.org/api/invites#join-requests>`_.

channels.ToggleJoinToSend.desc: Set whether all users `should join a discussion group in order to comment on a post » <https://core.telegram.org/api/discussion#requiring-users-to-join-the-group>`_

channels.DeactivateAllUsernames.desc: Disable all purchased usernames of a supergroup or channel

channels.ToggleForum.desc: Enable or disable `forum functionality <https://core.telegram.org/api/forum>`_ in a supergroup.

params.tabs: If true enables the tabbed forum UI, otherwise enables the list-based forum UI.

channels.UpdateColor.desc: Update the `accent color and background custom emoji » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors>`_ of a channel.

params.for_profile: Whether to change the accent color emoji pattern of the profile page; otherwise, the accent color and emoji pattern of messages will be changed. Channels can change both message and profile palettes; supergroups can only change the profile palette, of course after reaching the `appropriate boost level <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors>`_.
params.channel: Channel whose accent color should be changed.
params.color: `ID of the accent color palette » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors>`_ to use (not RGB24, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors>`_ for more info); if not set, the default palette is used.
params.background_emoji_id: Custom emoji ID used in the accent color pattern.

channels.GetChannelRecommendations.desc: Obtain a list of similarly themed public channels, selected based on similarities in their **subscriber bases**.

params.channel: The method will return channels related to the passed ``channel``. If not set, the method will returns channels related to channels the user has joined.

channels.SetBoostsToUnblockRestrictions.desc: Admins with `ban_users admin rights » <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/chatAdminRights>`_ may allow users that apply a certain number of `booosts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ to the group to bypass `slow mode » <https://core.telegram.org/method/channels.toggleSlowMode>`_ and `other » <https://core.telegram.org/api/rights#default-rights>`_ supergroup restrictions, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost#bypass-slowmode-and-chat-restrictions>`_ for more info.

params.boosts: The number of required boosts (1-8, 0 to disable).

params.msg_id: Message ID that was mistakenly deleted by the `native antispam <https://core.telegram.org/api/antispam>`_ system, taken from the `admin log <https://core.telegram.org/api/recent-actions>`_

channels.ToggleParticipantsHidden.desc: Hide or display the participants list in a `supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_.

params.enabled: If true, will hide the participants list; otherwise will unhide it.

channels.ToggleViewForumAsMessages.desc: Users may also choose to display messages from all topics of a `forum <https://core.telegram.org/api/forum>`_ as if they were sent to a normal group, using a "View as messages" setting in the local client: this setting only affects the current account, and is synced to other logged in sessions using this method.

params.enabled: The new value of the ``view_forum_as_messages`` flag.

channels.UpdateEmojiStatus.desc: Set an `emoji status <https://core.telegram.org/api/emoji-status>`_ for a channel or supergroup.

params.channel: The channel/supergroup, must have at least `channel_emoji_status_level_min <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#channel-emoji-status-level-min>`_ / `group_emoji_status_level_min <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#group-emoji-status-level-min>`_ boosts.

channels.GetMessageAuthor.desc: Can only be invoked by non-bot admins of a `monoforum » <https://core.telegram.org/api/monoforum>`_, obtains the original sender of a message sent by other monoforum admins to the monoforum, on behalf of the channel associated to the monoforum.

params.id: ID of the message sent by a monoforum admin.

channels.UpdatePaidMessagesPrice.desc: Enable or disable `paid messages » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`_ in this `supergroup <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_ or `monoforum <https://core.telegram.org/api/monoforum>`_.

params.broadcast_messages_allowed: Only usable for channels, enables or disables the associated `monoforum aka direct messages <https://core.telegram.org/api/monoforum>`_.
params.channel: Pass the supergroup ID for supergroups and the ID of the `channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_ to modify the setting in the associated monoforum.
params.send_paid_messages_stars: Specifies the required amount of `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ users must pay to send messages to the supergroup or monoforum.

channels.CheckSearchPostsFlood.desc: Check if the specified `global post search » <https://core.telegram.org/api/search#posts-tab>`_ requires payment.

channels.SetEmojiStickers.desc: Set a `custom emoji stickerset <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ for supergroups. Only usable after reaching at least the `boost level » <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ specified in the `group_emoji_stickers_level_min » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#group-emoji-stickers-level-min>`_ config parameter.

params.stickerset: The custom emoji stickerset to associate to the supergroup

channels.RestrictSponsoredMessages.desc: Disable ads on the specified channel, for all users.

channels.ToggleAutotranslation.desc: Toggle autotranslation in a channel, for all users: see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/translation#autotranslation-for-channels>`_ for more info.

params.channel: The channel where to toggle autotranslation.
params.enabled: Whether to enable or disable autotranslation.

channels.SearchPosts.desc: Globally search for posts from public `channels » <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_ ( *including* those we aren't a member of) containing either a specific hashtag, *or* a full text query.

params.hashtag: The hashtag to search, without the ``#`` character.
params.query: The full text query: each user has a limited amount of free full text search slots, after which payment is required, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/search#posts-tab>`_ for more info on the full flow.
params.offset_rate: Initially 0, then set to the `next_rate parameter of messages.messagesSlice <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messages.messagesSlice>`_, or if that is absent, the ``date`` of the last returned message.
params.offset_peer: `Offsets for pagination, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_
params.offset_id: `Offsets for pagination, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_
params.allow_paid_stars: For full text post searches ( ``query`` ), allows payment of the specified amount of Stars for the search, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/search#posts-tab>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.bot: The bot that owns the Main Mini App.

bots.SetBotBroadcastDefaultAdminRights.desc: Set the default `suggested admin rights <https://core.telegram.org/api/rights#suggested-bot-rights>`_ for bots being added as admins to channels, see `here for more info on how to handle them » <https://core.telegram.org/api/rights#suggested-bot-rights>`_.

params.custom_method: Identifier of the custom method to invoke
