params.bot: The bot that owns the Main Mini App.
params.lang_code: Fetch previews for the specified ISO 639-1 language code.

bots.CheckDownloadFileParams.desc: Check if a `mini app <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps>`_ can request the download of a specific file: called when handling `web_app_request_file_download events » <https://core.telegram.org/api/web-events#web-app-request-file-download>`_

params.bot: The bot that owns the `mini app <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps>`_ that requested the download

bots.UpdateStarRefProgram.desc: Create, edit or delete the `affiliate program <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`_ of a bot we own

params.bot: The bot
params.commission_permille: The permille commission rate: it indicates the share of Telegram Stars received by affiliates for every transaction made by users they referred inside of the bot. The minimum and maximum values for this parameter are contained in the `starref_min_commission_permille <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#starref-min-commission-permille>`_ and `starref_max_commission_permille <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#starref-max-commission-permille>`_ client configuration parameters. bots.GetBotRecommendations.desc: Obtain a list of similarly themed bots, selected based on similarities in their subscriber bases, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/recommend>`_ for more info.

params.bot: The bot that owns the Mini App
params.webapp_req_id: The Mini App request ID, taken from the `web_app_request_chat <https://core.telegram.org/api/web-events#web-app-request-chat>`_ event's ``req_id``

bots.CheckUsername.desc: Check whether a username is available and valid for use when `creating a managed bot » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/managed-bots#creating-a-managed-bot>`_.

bots.CreateBot.desc: Create a `managed bot » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/managed-bots#creating-a-managed-bot>`_ owned by the current user and controlled by the specified manager bot.

bots.GetAccessSettings.desc: Get the `access restriction settings » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/managed-bots#managing-a-managed-bot>`_ of a managed bot; can only be called by the manager bot.

payments.GetPremiumGiftCodeOptions.desc: Obtain a list of Telegram Premium `giveaway/gift code » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_ options.

params.boost_peer: The channel that will start the giveaway

payments.GetStarsTopupOptions.desc: Obtain a list of `Telegram Stars topup options » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#buying-or-gifting-stars>`_ as `starsTopupOption <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starsTopupOption>`_ constructors.

payments.AssignPlayMarketTransaction.desc: Informs server about a purchase made through the Play Store: for official applications only.

params.peer: The peer where to launch the giveaway.

payments.GetStarsStatus.desc: Get the current `Telegram Stars balance <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ of the current account (with peer= `inputPeerSelf <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPeerSelf>`_ ), or the stars balance of the bot or channel specified in ``peer``.

params.ton: If set, returns the channel/ad revenue balance in nanograms.
params.peer: Peer of which to get the balance.

payments.GetGiveawayInfo.desc: Obtain information about a `Telegram Premium giveaway » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_.

params.peer: The peer where the giveaway was posted.
params.msg_id: Message ID of the `messageActionGiveawayLaunch <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionGiveawayLaunch>`_ service message

payments.CheckGiftCode.desc: Obtain information about a `Telegram Premium giftcode » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_

params.slug: The giftcode to check

payments.RefundStarsCharge.desc: Refund a `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ transaction, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/payments#6-refunds>`_ for more info.

payments.SendStarsForm.desc: Make a payment using `Telegram Stars, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#using-stars>`_ for more info.

params.inbound: If set, fetches only incoming transactions.
params.outbound: If set, fetches only outgoing transactions.
params.ascending: Return transactions in ascending order by date (instead of descending order by date).
params.ton: If set, returns the channel/ad revenue transactions in nanograms, instead.
params.subscription_id: If set, fetches only transactions for the specified `Telegram Star subscription » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#star-subscriptions>`_.
params.peer: Fetch the transaction history of the peer ( `inputPeerSelf <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPeerSelf>`_ or a bot we own).
params.offset: `Offset for pagination, obtained from the returned next_offset, initially an empty string » <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

payments.GetStarsGiftOptions.desc: Obtain a list of `Telegram Stars gift options » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#buying-or-gifting-stars>`_ as `starsGiftOption <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starsGiftOption>`_ constructors.

payments.GetStarsRevenueAdsAccountUrl.desc: Returns a URL for a Telegram Ad platform account that can be used to set up advertisements for channel/bot in ``peer``, paid using the Telegram Stars owned by the specified ``peer``, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#paying-for-ads>`_ for more info.

params.peer: Channel or bot that owns the stars.

payments.GetStarsRevenueWithdrawalUrl.desc: Withdraw funds from a channel or bot's `star balance » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#withdrawing-revenue>`_.

params.ton: If set, withdraws channel/ad revenue in TON.
params.peer: Channel or bot from which to withdraw funds.
params.amount: The amount of stars or nanograms to withdraw.

params.dark: Whether to enable dark theme for graph colors
params.ton: If set, fetches channel/bot ad revenue statistics in TON.
params.peer: Get statistics for the specified bot, channel or ourselves ( `inputPeerSelf <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPeerSelf>`_ ).

payments.GetStarsSubscriptions.desc: Obtain a list of active, expired or cancelled `Telegram Star subscriptions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/invites#paid-invite-links>`_.

params.missing_balance: Whether to return only subscriptions expired due to an excessively low Telegram Star balance.
params.offset: Offset for pagination, taken from `payments.starsStatus <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/payments.starsStatus>`_. ``subscriptions_next_offset``.

payments.ChangeStarsSubscription.desc: Activate or deactivate a `Telegram Star subscription » <https://core.telegram.org/api/invites#paid-invite-links>`_.

params.canceled: Whether to cancel or reactivate the subscription.

payments.SaveStarGift.desc: Display or remove a `received or hosted gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#hosted-collectible-gifts>`_ from our profile.

params.unsave: If set, hides the gift from our profile.
params.stargift: The gift to display or remove. A `hosted collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#hosted-collectible-gifts>`_ may be used by its host or owner.

payments.GetStarsTransactionsByID.desc: Obtain info about `Telegram Star transactions » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars#balance-and-transaction-history>`_ using specific transaction IDs.

params.ton: If set, returns channel/bot ad revenue transactions in nanograms.

payments.GetStarGifts.desc: Get a list of available `gifts, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ for more info.

params.hash: `Hash used for caching, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_.The hash may be generated locally by using the ``id`` s of the returned or stored sticker `starGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGift>`_ s.

payments.ConvertStarGift.desc: Convert a `received gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ into Telegram Stars: this will permanently destroy the gift, converting it into `starGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGift>`_. ``convert_stars`` `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_, added to the user's balance.

payments.GetStarsGiveawayOptions.desc: Fetch a list of `star giveaway options » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways#star-giveaways>`_.

params.restore: If **not** set, disables autorenewal of the subscriptions, and prevents the user from reactivating the subscription once the current period expires: a subscription cancelled by the bot will have the `starsSubscription <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starsSubscription>`_. ``bot_canceled`` flag set. The bot can can partially undo this operation by setting this flag: this will allow the user to reactivate the subscription.
params.user_id: The ID of the user whose subscription should be (un)cancelled
params.charge_id: The ``provider_charge_id`` from the `messageActionPaymentSentMe <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionPaymentSentMe>`_ service message sent to the bot for the first subscription payment.

payments.FulfillStarsSubscription.desc: Re-join a private channel associated to an active `Telegram Star subscription » <https://core.telegram.org/api/invites#paid-invite-links>`_.

payments.GetConnectedStarRefBots.desc: Fetch all affiliations we have created for a certain peer

params.offset_date: If set, returns only results older than the specified unixtime
params.offset_link: Offset for `pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_, taken from the last returned `connectedBotStarRef <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/connectedBotStarRef>`_. ``url`` (initially empty)
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

params.revoked: If set, leaves the bot's affiliate program

payments.GetSuggestedStarRefBots.desc: Obtain a list of suggested `mini apps <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/webapps>`_ with available `affiliate programs <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`_

params.order_by_revenue: If set, orders results by the expected revenue
params.order_by_date: If set, orders results by the creation date of the affiliate program
params.peer: The peer that will become the affiliate: star commissions will be transferred to this peer's star balance.
params.offset: Offset for pagination, taken from `payments.suggestedStarRefBots <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/payments.suggestedStarRefBots>`_. ``next_offset``, initially empty.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

payments.GetStarGiftUpgradePreview.desc: Obtain a preview of the possible attributes (chosen randomly) a `gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ can receive after upgrading it to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ for more info.

payments.GetConnectedStarRefBot.desc: Fetch info about a specific `bot affiliation » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals>`_

params.bot: The bot that offers the affiliate program

payments.ConnectStarRefBot.desc: Join a bot's `affiliate program, becoming an affiliate » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/referrals#becoming-an-affiliate>`_

params.peer: The peer that will become the affiliate: star commissions will be transferred to this peer's star balance.
params.bot: The bot that offers the affiliate program

payments.GetSavedStarGifts.desc: Fetch the full list of `gifts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#list-all-received-gifts>`_ owned, received or `hosted » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#hosted-collectible-gifts>`_ by a peer.

params.exclude_unsaved: Exclude gifts not pinned on the profile.
params.exclude_saved: Exclude gifts pinned on the profile.
params.exclude_unlimited: Exclude gifts that do not have the `starGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGift>`_. ``limited`` flag set.
params.sort_by_value: If set, sorts the gifts by price instead of reception date.
params.exclude_upgradable: Exclude gifts that can be `upgraded to collectible gifts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.
params.exclude_unupgradable: Exclude gifts that cannot be `upgraded to collectible gifts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.
params.peer_color_available: If set, only returns `collectible gifts <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ whose palette can be used as a `collectible message palette » <https://core.telegram.org/api/colors#collectible-message-palettes>`_.
params.exclude_hosted: If set, excludes `hosted collectible gifts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#hosted-collectible-gifts>`_, returning only gifts owned or received by ``peer``.
params.peer: Fetch only gifts owned, received or `hosted » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#hosted-collectible-gifts>`_ by the specified peer, such as: a user, with peer= `inputPeerUser <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPeerUser>`_; a channel, with peer= `inputPeerChannel <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPeerChannel>`_; a `connected business user » <https://core.telegram.org/api/bots/connected-business-bots>`_ (when executing the method as a bot, over the business connection), with peer= `inputPeerUser <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPeerUser>`_.
params.collection_id: Only returns gifts within the specified `collection » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#gift-collections>`_.
params.offset: `Offset for pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

payments.TransferStarGift.desc: Transfer a `collectible gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ to another user or channel: can only be used if transfer is free (i.e. `messageActionStarGiftUnique <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionStarGiftUnique>`_. ``transfer_stars`` is not set); see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#transferring-collectible-gifts>`_ for more info on the full flow (including the different flow to use in case the transfer isn't free).

payments.UpgradeStarGift.desc: Upgrade a `gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ to a `collectible gift <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_: can only be used if the upgrade was already paid by the gift sender; see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#upgrade-a-gift-to-a-collectible-gift>`_ for more info on the full flow (including the different flow to use in case the upgrade was not paid by the gift sender).

params.keep_original_details: Set this flag to keep the original gift text, sender and receiver in the upgraded gift as a `starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAttributeOriginalDetails>`_ attribute.

payments.ToggleChatStarGiftNotifications.desc: Enables or disables the reception of notifications every time a `gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ is received by the specified channel, can only be invoked by admins with ``post_messages`` `admin rights <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/chatAdminRights>`_.

params.enabled: Whether to enable or disable reception of notifications in the form of `messageActionStarGiftUnique <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionStarGiftUnique>`_ and `messageActionStarGift <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionStarGift>`_ service messages from the channel.
params.peer: The channel for which to receive or not receive notifications.

payments.GetUniqueStarGift.desc: Obtain info about a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ using a slug obtained from a `collectible gift link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#collectible-gift-link>`_.

params.slug: The slug.

payments.CanPurchaseStore.desc: Checks whether a purchase is possible. Must be called before in-store purchase, official apps only.

params.peer: Peer where to create the collection.
params.title: Title of the collection.

payments.GetSavedStarGift.desc: Fetch info about specific `gifts <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ owned by a peer we control.

params.stargift: List of gifts to fetch info about.

payments.ToggleStarGiftsPinnedToTop.desc: Pins a received gift on top of the profile of the user or owned channels by using `payments.toggleStarGiftsPinnedToTop <https://core.telegram.org/method/payments.toggleStarGiftsPinnedToTop>`_.

params.peer: The peer where to pin the gift.

payments.GetStarGiftWithdrawalUrl.desc: Convert a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ to an NFT on the TON blockchain.

params.password: The current user's 2FA password, passed as `specified here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/srp>`_.

payments.UpdateStarGiftPrice.desc: A `collectible gift we own » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ can be put up for sale on the `gift marketplace » <https://telegram.org/blog/gift-marketplace-and-more>`_ with this method, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`_ for more info.

payments.GetResaleStarGifts.desc: Get `collectible gifts <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ of a specific type currently on resale, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#reselling-collectible-gifts>`_ for more info.

params.for_craft: Only return collectible gifts that can be bought and used for `crafting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`_; render each returned gift's `starGiftUnique <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftUnique>`_. ``craft_chance_permille`` as its crafting success contribution.
params.stars_only: Only return gifts that can be bought using `Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_.
params.attributes_hash: If a previous call to the method was made and `payments.resaleStarGifts <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/payments.resaleStarGifts>`_. ``attributes_hash`` was set, pass it here to avoid returning any results if they haven't changed. Otherwise, set this flag and pass ``0`` to return `payments.resaleStarGifts <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/payments.resaleStarGifts>`_. ``attributes_hash`` and `payments.resaleStarGifts <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/payments.resaleStarGifts>`_. ``attributes``, **these two fields will not be set** if this flag is not set.
params.gift_id: Mandatory identifier of the base gift from which the collectible gift was upgraded.
params.attributes: Optionally filter gifts with the specified attributes. If no attributes of a specific type are specified, all attributes of that type are allowed.
params.offset: Offset for pagination. If not equal to an empty string, `payments.resaleStarGifts <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/payments.resaleStarGifts>`_. ``counters`` will not be set to avoid returning the counters every time a new page is fetched.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

payments.UpdateStarGiftCollection.desc: Add or remove gifts from a `star gift collection » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#gift-collections>`_, or rename the collection.

params.title: Title of the collection, to rename the collection.
params.delete_stargift: Can contain a list of gifts to remove from the collection.
params.add_stargift: Can contain a list of gifts to add to the collection.
params.order: Can contain the new gift order.

payments.GetStarGiftCollections.desc: Fetches all `star gift collections » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#gift-collections>`_ of a peer.

params.hash: Hash ( `generated as specified here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets#hash-generation>`_ ) using the `starGiftCollection <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftCollection>`_. ``hash`` field ( **not** the ``collection_id`` field) of all collections returned by a previous method call, to avoid refetching the result if it hasn't changed.

payments.CheckCanSendGift.desc: Check if the specified `gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts>`_ can be sent.

payments.ReorderStarGiftCollections.desc: Reorder the `star gift collections » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#gift-collections>`_ on an owned peer's profile.

payments.GetStarGiftAuctionAcquiredGifts.desc: Fetches all the gifts that the current user won in an `auction <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_.

params.gift_id: The gift ID linked to the auction.

payments.GetUniqueStarGiftValueInfo.desc: Get information about the value of a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.

params.slug: ``slug`` from a `starGiftUnique <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftUnique>`_.

payments.ResolveStarGiftOffer.desc: Accept or decline a previously received `collectible gift purchase offer » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gift-purchase-offers>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gift-purchase-offers>`_ for the full flow.

params.decline: If set, declines the offer; otherwise, accepts it.
params.offer_msg_id: Identifier of the `messageActionStarGiftPurchaseOffer <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionStarGiftPurchaseOffer>`_ service message describing the offer to act upon.

payments.SendStarGiftOffer.desc: Send an offer to purchase a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gift-purchase-offers>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gift-purchase-offers>`_ for the full flow.

params.peer: Owner of the collectible gift: equal to `starGiftUnique <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftUnique>`_. ``owner_id``.
params.slug: Identifier of the collectible gift: equal to `starGiftUnique <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftUnique>`_. ``slug``.
params.price: Offer price, in stars or TON.
params.duration: Duration of the offer, in seconds: must be one of ``21600``, ``43200``, ``86400``, ``129600``, ``172800``, or ``259200``; can also be ``120`` in test mode.
params.random_id: Random 64-bit identifier used to avoid sending the same offer twice in case of network issues. See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates#updatemessageid-updates>`_ for more info on random ID deduplication and updateMessageID mapping.
params.allow_paid_stars: If the destination peer has `paid messages » <https://core.telegram.org/api/paid-messages>`_ enabled, specifies the amount of `Telegram Stars <https://core.telegram.org/api/stars>`_ the sending user has agreed to pay in order to send the offer (in addition to the amount for the offer itself, contained in ``price`` ).

payments.GetStarGiftActiveAuctions.desc: Fetches all currently active `gift auctions <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_ **the user has ever bid on** (including auctions where the user was outbid and their bid was returned), as long as the auction hasn't ended yet.

params.hash: Hash generated `as specified here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_

payments.GetStarGiftAuctionState.desc: Returns info about a `collectible gift auction » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_; also subscribes the user to auction updates, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/auctions>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.auction: Either the ID of the gift linked to the auction, or an `auction deep link slug » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#auction-links>`_.
params.version: Initially ``0``, then set to the returned `starGiftAuctionState <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftAuctionState>`_. ``version``, to avoid refetching results if they haven't changed.

payments.GetStarGiftUpgradeAttributes.desc: Obtains the **full** list of just the collectible attributes that may appear for a gift type once it's upgraded to a `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_.

payments.CraftStarGift.desc: Craft a new `collectible gift » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ by combining 1 to 4 owned collectible gifts of the same base gift type.

params.stargift: 1 to 4 owned collectible gifts of the same type to use for `crafting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`_. The first gift's ID is reused if crafting succeeds.

params.masks: Whether this is a mask stickerset
params.emojis: Whether this is a `custom emoji <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ stickerset.
params.text_color: Whether the color of TGS custom emojis contained in this set should be changed to the text color when used in messages, the accent color if used as emoji status, white on chat photos, or another appropriate color based on context. For custom emoji stickersets only.
params.title: Stickerset name, ``1-64`` chars
params.short_name: Short name of sticker set, to be used in `sticker deep links » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#stickerset-links>`_. Can contain only english letters, digits and underscores. Must begin with a letter, can't contain consecutive underscores and, **if called by a bot**, must end in ``"_by_<bot_username>"``. ``<bot_username>`` is case insensitive. 1-64 characters.
params.software: Used when `importing stickers using the sticker import SDKs <https://core.telegram.org/import-stickers>`_, specifies the name of the software that created the stickers

payments.GetCraftStarGifts.desc: Obtain owned `collectible gifts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#collectible-gifts>`_ of a specific type that can be used for `crafting » <https://core.telegram.org/api/gifts#crafting-collectible-gifts>`_.

params.gift_id: Identifier of the base gift type, equal to `starGiftUnique <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/starGiftUnique>`_. ``gift_id`` of the first selected gift.
params.offset: Offset for pagination.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

stickers.RemoveStickerFromSet.desc: Remove a sticker from the set where it belongs. The sticker set must have been created by the current user/bot.

params.thumb: Thumbnail (only for normal stickersets, not custom emoji stickersets).
params.thumb_document_id: Only for `custom emoji stickersets <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_, ID of a custom emoji present in the set to use as thumbnail; pass 0 to fallback to the first custom emoji of the set.

stickers.ChangeStickerPosition.desc: Changes the absolute position of a sticker in the set to which it belongs. The sticker set must have been created by the current user/bot.

params.position: The new position of the sticker, zero-based

stickers.AddStickerToSet.desc: Add a sticker to a stickerset. The sticker set must have been created by the current user/bot.

stickers.CheckShortName.desc: Check whether the given short name is available

stickers.SuggestShortName.desc: Suggests a short name for a given stickerpack name

stickers.ChangeSticker.desc: Update the keywords, emojis or `mask coordinates <https://core.telegram.org/api/stickers#mask-stickers>`_ of a sticker.

params.emoji: If set, updates the emoji list associated to the sticker
params.keywords: If set, updates the sticker keywords (separated by commas). Can't be provided for mask stickers.

phone.GetCallConfig.desc: DEPRECATED: Get phone call configuration to be passed to the libtgvoip (deprecated) shared config.

phone.RequestCall.desc: Start a telegram phone call, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/calls#one-to-one-calls>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.video: Whether to start a video call
params.random_id: Random ID to avoid resending the same object. See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates#updatemessageid-updates>`_ for more info on random ID deduplication and updateMessageID mapping.

phone.AcceptCall.desc: Accept incoming call, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/calls#one-to-one-calls>`_ for more info on the full flow.

phone.SetCallRating.desc: Rate a call, returns info about the rating message sent to the official VoIP bot, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/calls#call-rating>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.user_initiative: Whether the user decided on their own initiative to rate the call, must NOT be set if rating was requested by the server with `phoneCallDiscarded <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/phoneCallDiscarded>`_. ``need_rating``.
params.comment: An additional comment with problem hashtags, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/calls#call-rating>`_ for more info on the full flow.

phone.SaveCallDebug.desc: Send `phone call <https://core.telegram.org/api/calls#call-debug>`_ debug data to server.

phone.CreateGroupCall.desc: Create a video chat or livestream, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`_ for the full flow.

params.rtmp_stream: Create the call in `RTMP livestream mode » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#stream-mode>`_, where one external streamer publishes all audio and video
params.peer: Associate the group call or livestream to the provided `group/supergroup/channel <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel>`_
params.random_id: Unique client message ID required to prevent creation of duplicate group calls. See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates#updatemessageid-updates>`_ for more info on random ID deduplication and updateMessageID mapping.
params.title: Call title, if not set defaults to the group/channel's name.
params.schedule_date: Schedule date, at least 10 seconds and at most 8 days in the future; the call must still be manually started using `phone.startScheduledGroupCall <https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.startScheduledGroupCall>`_

phone.SendSignalingData.desc: Send VoIP `signaling data <https://core.telegram.org/api/calls#signaling-data>`_ for an ongoing phone call.

phone.DiscardCall.desc: Refuse or end running call, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/calls#one-to-one-calls>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.video: Whether this is a video call

phone.ConfirmCall.desc: `Complete phone call E2E encryption key exchange » <https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end/voice-calls>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/calls#one-to-one-calls>`_ for more info on the full flow.

phone.ReceivedCall.desc: Optional: notify the server that the user is currently busy in a call: this will automatically refuse all incoming phone calls until the current phone call is ended, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/calls#one-to-one-calls>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.peer: The phone call we're currently in

phone.LeaveGroupCall.desc: Leave a group call without ending it for other participants. This method can be used with all group call types, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#managing-an-active-group-call>`_ for more info.

params.call: Group call to leave
params.source: Source ID of the main group call stream

phone.JoinGroupCall.desc: Join any `group call type » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#group-call-types>`_. Conference calls additionally require the `E2E joining flow » <https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end/group-calls#joining-a-call>`_.

params.muted: Join muted; required for live story listeners and RTMP-mode viewers
params.video_stopped: Join with video disabled; required for live story listeners and RTMP-mode viewers
params.call: Group call to join
params.join_as: Join the group call, presenting yourself as the specified user/channel; this peer is also used as the author of in-call messages in normal video chats/livestreams. Only video chats/livestreams may use another peer; this field must be equal to `inputPeerSelf <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/inputPeerSelf>`_ when joining `live stories » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#live-stories>`_ or `conference calls » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#conference-calls>`_.
params.invite_hash: The invitation hash from the `invite link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#video-chat-livestream-links>`_, if provided allows speaking in a livestream or muted group call ( `video chats/livestreams » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`_ only, cannot be used by `live stories » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#live-stories>`_ or `conference calls » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#conference-calls>`_ ).
params.public_key: For `conference calls » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#conference-calls>`_ only, your public key.
params.block: The `main-chain block that adds the joining user » <https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end/group-calls#joining-a-call>`_, only for `conference calls » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#conference-calls>`_.
params.params: Join payload generated by the local tgcalls group-call engine, as described above

phone.DiscardGroupCall.desc: Terminate a group call, ending the room for all participants. This method can be used with all group call types, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#managing-an-active-group-call>`_ for more info.

params.call: The group call to terminate

phone.InviteToGroupCall.desc: Invite a set of users to a `video chat/livestream » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`_; cannot be used for `live stories » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#live-stories>`_ or `conference calls » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#conference-calls>`_.

params.call: The `video chat/livestream » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`_

phone.ToggleGroupCallRecord.desc: Start or stop recording a video chat/livestream, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`_ for more info. The recorded audio and video streams will be automatically sent to Saved Messages (the chat with ourselves).

params.start: Whether to start or stop recording
params.video: Whether to also record video streams
params.call: Video chat/livestream to record
params.title: Recording title
params.video_portrait: If video stream recording is enabled, whether to record in portrait or landscape mode

phone.ToggleGroupCallSettings.desc: Change group call settings. Each setting supports different group call types, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#managing-an-active-group-call>`_ for more info.

params.reset_invite_hash: Invalidate existing invite links for video chats, livestreams and conferences
params.call: Group call whose settings should be changed
params.join_muted: Whether users joining a non-RTMP video chat/livestream should be muted by default
params.messages_enabled: Enable or disable the in-call message overlay in video chats/livestreams, conferences and live stories, including in RTMP mode
params.send_paid_messages_stars: Set the minimum Telegram Stars donation required from users other than the live story owner for each comment; the owner may always comment without donating, and ``0`` allows free comments for everyone

phone.CheckGroupCall.desc: Check which of the specified source IDs the server still recognizes as joined to a group call. This method can be used with all group call types, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#maintaining-group-call-connections>`_ for more info.

params.call: Group call whose WebRTC connections should be checked
params.sources: Non-zero SSRC/source IDs of the caller's main and presentation connections

params.call: Group call whose participants should be fetched
params.ids: If specified, will fetch group participant info about the specified peers
params.sources: If specified, will fetch group participant info about the specified WebRTC source IDs
params.offset: Offset for results, taken from the ``next_offset`` field of `phone.groupParticipants <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/phone.groupParticipants>`_ or the ``participants_next_offset`` field of `phone.groupCall <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/phone.groupCall>`_, initially an empty string. Note: if no more results are available, the method call will return an empty ``next_offset``; thus, avoid providing the ``next_offset`` returned in `phone.groupParticipants <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/phone.groupParticipants>`_ if it is empty, to avoid an infinite loop.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

phone.EditGroupCallParticipant.desc: Edit information about a participant of a non-RTMP video chat/livestream or conference. The ``raise_hand`` field is only supported in video chats/livestreams, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#managing-an-active-group-call>`_ for more info.

params.call: Non-RTMP video chat/livestream or conference
params.participant: The group call participant (can also be the user itself)
params.muted: Change the participant's mute state; allowing a forcibly muted participant to self-unmute does not immediately unmute them
params.volume: New volume, between ``1`` and ``20000``; ``10000`` represents 100%. Without moderation rights, changing another participant's volume affects only local playback
params.raise_hand: Raise or lower hand; only supported in video chats/livestreams
params.video_stopped: Start or stop the current user's video stream
params.video_paused: Pause or resume the current user's video stream
params.presentation_paused: Pause or resume the current user's presentation stream

phone.GetGroupCall.desc: Get info about a `group call <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#getting-info-about-a-group-call>`_ and its participants.

params.call: Group call of any type to fetch
params.limit: Maximum number of participants to return in this call (0 to return a server-defined amount). If the number of returned participants is less than `groupCall <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/groupCall>`_. ``participants_count``, paginate through the remaining participants using `phone.getGroupParticipants <https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.getGroupParticipants>`_, passing to ``offset`` the `phone.groupCall <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/phone.groupCall>`_. ``participants_next_offset`` returned by this call. This parameter behaves in a different way compared to the ``limit`` of `phone.getGroupParticipants <https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.getGroupParticipants>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#getting-info-about-a-group-call>`_ for more info.

phone.EditGroupCallTitle.desc: Edit the title of a video chat or livestream. This method cannot be used with live stories or conferences, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`_ for more info.

params.call: Video chat or livestream whose title should be changed
params.title: New title

phone.ExportGroupCallInvite.desc: Get an invite link for a public `video chat/livestream » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`_.

params.can_self_unmute: For public video chats/livestreams, group call admins only: allow users that join using this link to speak without explicitly requesting permission, for example by raising their hand.
params.call: The public `video chat/livestream » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`_

phone.GetGroupCallJoinAs.desc: Get a list of peers that can be used to join a `video chat or livestream » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#joining-a-group-call-on-behalf-of-owned-channels>`_, presenting yourself as a specific user/channel.

params.peer: The basic group, supergroup or channel whose video chat/livestream we're trying to join; cannot target a live story.

params.call: Scheduled video chat/livestream to start, before or after its scheduled date

phone.ToggleGroupCallStartSubscription.desc: Subscribe or unsubscribe to a scheduled `group call <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#video-chats-livestreams>`_.

params.call: Scheduled video chat/livestream that has not started yet
params.subscribed: Whether to receive a service-notification message when the call starts

phone.JoinGroupCallPresentation.desc: Start screen sharing in a non-RTMP video chat/livestream or conference. Presentations are not supported in live stories or RTMP-mode video chats/livestreams, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#presentations>`_ for more info.

params.call: Joined non-RTMP video chat/livestream or conference in which to start presenting
params.params: Join payload generated by a separate local call-engine instance for the presentation

phone.SaveDefaultGroupCallJoinAs.desc: Set the default peer used to join a `video chat/livestream » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#joining-a-group-call-on-behalf-of-owned-channels>`_ associated with a specific dialog.

params.peer: Basic group, supergroup or channel whose video chat/livestream default should be changed
params.join_as: Eligible peer to use by default when joining the dialog's video chats/livestreams, selected from `phone.getGroupCallJoinAs <https://core.telegram.org/method/phone.getGroupCallJoinAs>`_

params.only_left: Whether this is a removal of members that already left the conference call.
params.kick: Whether this is a forced removal of active members in a conference call.
params.call: Conference from which to remove participants
params.ids: User IDs to remove from the conference and E2E blockchain
params.block: Main-chain block removing the specified users and establishing a new shared key, see `removing a participant » <https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end/group-calls#removing-a-participant>`_

phone.SendConferenceCallBroadcast.desc: Submit a verification message to conference call subchain ``1``, see `subchains » <https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end/group-calls#subchains>`_.

params.call: Conference whose verification subchain should receive the message

phone.SaveCallLog.desc: Deprecated: send libtgvoip phone call debug information

phone.InviteConferenceCallParticipant.desc: Invite a user to a `conference call <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#conference-calls>`_.

params.video: Whether this is a video conference invitation
params.call: The conference call.

phone.LeaveGroupCallPresentation.desc: Stop screen sharing in a non-RTMP video chat/livestream or conference. Presentations are not supported in live stories or RTMP-mode video chats/livestreams, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#presentations>`_ for more info.

params.call: Group call whose presentation connection should be stopped

phone.GetGroupCallStreamRtmpUrl.desc: Get the RTMP URL and stream key used by the single external streamer that publishes all audio and video for an RTMP-mode video chat, livestream or live story.

params.live_story: Obtain credentials for an RTMP live story instead of a video chat/livestream
params.peer: Peer that will host the RTMP video chat, livestream or live story
params.revoke: Whether to invalidate the previous stream key and generate a new one, instead of returning the existing key

phone.CreateConferenceCall.desc: Create and optionally join a new `conference call » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#conference-calls>`_.

params.muted: If set, mute our microphone when joining the call (can only be used if ``join`` is set).
params.video_stopped: If set, our video stream is disabled (can only be used if ``join`` is set).
params.join: If set, also join the call, otherwise just create the call link.
params.random_id: Unique client message ID required to prevent creation of duplicate group calls. See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates#updatemessageid-updates>`_ for more info on random ID deduplication and updateMessageID mapping.
params.public_key: Fresh E2E public key for the creator (can only be used if ``join`` is set).
params.block: Initial main-chain block for subchain ``0`` (can only be used if ``join`` is set).
params.params: Join payload generated by the local call engine (can only be used if ``join`` is set).

phone.GetGroupCallStreamChannels.desc:
Get the available stream channels and current playback timestamp of an RTMP-mode video chat, livestream or live story, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#rtmp-mode>`_ for the full flow.
The group call must be joined before invoking this method. Send the request to the media DC specified by `groupCall <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/groupCall>`_. ``stream_dc_id``.

params.call: RTMP-mode video chat, livestream or live story

phone.GetGroupCallChainBlocks.desc: Fetch blocks from a conference call `subchain » <https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end/group-calls#subchains>`_; handle the returned `updateGroupCallChainBlocks <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updateGroupCallChainBlocks>`_ as `specified here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end/group-calls#handling-updates>`_.

params.call: Conference whose subchain blocks should be fetched
params.sub_chain_id: ``0`` for the main state blockchain, ``1`` for the call verification subchain
params.offset: Fetch blocks starting from this height; pass ``-1`` to fetch the latest block
params.limit: Maximum number of blocks to return in this call, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_, max 100.

phone.SendGroupCallEncryptedMessage.desc: Send an E2E-encrypted message or emoji reaction to all participants of a conference call. This method can only be used with conferences; see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end/group-calls#conference-in-call-messages>`_ for the serialization and encryption process.

params.call: Conference call that should receive the encrypted message or reaction
params.encrypted_message: Complete encrypted message or reaction packet produced as specified `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/end-to-end/group-calls#encrypting-and-sending-a-message>`_

phone.DeleteGroupCallMessages.desc: Delete specific messages from the `in-call message overlay » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#in-call-messages>`_ of a video chat/livestream or live story, including in RTMP mode.

params.report_spam: When moderating another participant's messages, also report them as spam
params.call: Video chat/livestream or live story containing the messages
params.messages: IDs of the messages to delete

phone.GetGroupCallStars.desc: Fetch a live story's total donations and top donors, see `paid live story donations » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#paid-live-story-donations>`_.

params.call: Live story group call

params.msg_id: The ID of the `messageActionConferenceCall <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/messageActionConferenceCall>`_ to decline.

phone.SendGroupCallMessage.desc: Send an in-call message to all participants of a video chat/livestream or live story, including in RTMP mode, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#in-call-messages>`_ for more info.

params.call: Video chat/livestream or live story that should receive the message, reaction or donation
params.random_id: Fresh client-generated random ID used to deduplicate the message or donation. See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates#updatemessageid-updates>`_ for more info on random ID deduplication and updateMessageID mapping.
params.message: Message text or emoji reaction; pass an empty value when sending a standalone paid live story donation
params.allow_paid_stars: User-confirmed number of Telegram Stars to donate with a live story comment or standalone donation
params.send_as: Optional peer to display as the author of a live story message or reaction; can only be used for live stories

phone.DeleteGroupCallParticipantMessages.desc: As an admin, delete all messages from a specific participant in the `in-call message overlay » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#in-call-messages>`_ of a video chat/livestream or live story, including in RTMP mode.

params.report_spam: Also report the participant's messages as spam
params.call: Video chat/livestream or live story containing the messages
params.participant: The participant whose messages should be deleted

params.lang_code: Either an ISO 639-1 language code or a language pack name obtained from a `language pack link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#language-pack-links>`_.

langpack.GetLanguages.desc: Get information about all languages in a localization pack

langpack.GetStrings.desc: Get strings from a language pack

params.lang_code: Either an ISO 639-1 language code or a language pack name obtained from a `language pack link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#language-pack-links>`_.

phone.SaveDefaultSendAs.desc: Save the default peer displayed as the author of live story comments and reactions, see `in-call messages » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#in-call-messages>`_.

params.call: Live story group call
params.send_as: Peer to display as the author of subsequent comments and reactions

params.dark: Whether to enable dark theme for graph colors

langpack.GetDifference.desc: Get new strings in language pack

params.lang_code: Either an ISO 639-1 language code or a language pack name obtained from a `language pack link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#language-pack-links>`_.

langpack.GetLanguage.desc: Get information about a language in a localization pack

params.lang_code: Either an ISO 639-1 language code or a language pack name obtained from a `language pack link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#language-pack-links>`_.

stats.GetStoryPublicForwards.desc: Obtain forwards of a `story <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_ as a message to public chats and reposts by public channels.

params.peer: Peer where the story was originally posted
params.offset: Offset for pagination, from `stats.PublicForwards <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/stats.publicForwards>`_. ``next_offset``.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

chatlists.ExportChatlistInvite.desc: Export a `folder » <https://core.telegram.org/api/folders>`_, creating a `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_.

params.title: An optional name for the link
params.peers: The list of channels, group and supergroups to share with the link. Basic groups will automatically be `converted to supergroups <https://core.telegram.org/api/channel#migration>`_ when invoking the method.

params.dark: Whether to enable dark theme for graph colors

chatlists.GetExportedInvites.desc: List all `chat folder deep links » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_ associated to a folder

params.dark: Whether to enable dark theme for graph colors

stats.GetPollStats.desc: Get `statistics <https://core.telegram.org/api/stats#poll-statistics>`_ for a poll sent in a message.

params.dark: Whether to enable dark theme for graph colors
params.peer: The peer where the poll was sent
params.msg_id: ID of the message containing the poll

stats.GetMessagePublicForwards.desc:
Obtains a list of messages, indicating to which other public channels was a channel message forwarded.
Will return a list of `messages <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/message>`_ with ``peer_id`` equal to the public channel to which this message was forwarded.

params.offset: Offset for `pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_, empty string on first call, then use the ``next_offset`` field of the returned constructor (if present, otherwise no more results are available).
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

chatlists.DeleteExportedInvite.desc: Delete a previously created `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_.

params.slug: ``slug`` obtained from the `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_.
``slug`` obtained from the `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_.
params.title: If set, sets a new name for the link
params.peers: If set, changes the list of peers shared with the link

params.dark: Whether to enable the dark theme for graph colors
params.peer: The peer that posted the story

chatlists.JoinChatlistInvite.desc: Import a `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_, joining some or all the chats in the folder.

params.slug: ``slug`` obtained from a `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_.
params.peers: List of new chats to join, fetched using `chatlists.checkChatlistInvite <https://core.telegram.org/method/chatlists.checkChatlistInvite>`_ and filtered as specified in the `documentation » <https://core.telegram.org/api/folders#shared-folders>`_.

chatlists.CheckChatlistInvite.desc: Obtain information about a `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_.

params.slug: ``slug`` obtained from the `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_

chatlists.LeaveChatlist.desc: Delete a folder imported using a `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_

params.peers: Also leave the specified channels and groups

chatlists.JoinChatlistUpdates.desc: Join channels and supergroups recently added to a `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_.

params.peers: List of new chats to join, fetched using `chatlists.getChatlistUpdates <https://core.telegram.org/method/chatlists.getChatlistUpdates>`_ and filtered as specified in the `documentation » <https://core.telegram.org/api/folders#shared-folders>`_.

chatlists.HideChatlistUpdates.desc: Dismiss new pending peers recently added to a `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_.

chatlists.GetLeaveChatlistSuggestions.desc: Returns identifiers of pinned or always included chats from a chat folder imported using a `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_, which are suggested to be left when the chat folder is deleted.

params.peer: Peer where the story was posted.
params.media: If specified, replaces the story media.
params.media_areas: `Media areas <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#media-areas>`_ associated to the story, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#media-areas>`_ for more info.
params.caption: If specified, replaces the story caption.
params.entities: `Message entities for styled text in the caption <https://core.telegram.org/api/entities>`_, if allowed by the `stories_entities client configuration parameter » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#stories-entities>`_.
params.privacy_rules: If specified, alters the `privacy settings » <https://core.telegram.org/api/privacy>`_ of the story, changing who can or can't view the story.
params.music: If set, the new audio track to play as background music for the story.

stories.CanSendStory.desc: Check whether we can post stories as the specified peer.

params.peer: The peer from which we wish to post stories.

chatlists.GetChatlistUpdates.desc: Fetch new chats associated with an imported `chat folder deep link » <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#chat-folder-links>`_. Must be invoked at most every ``chatlist_update_period`` seconds (as per the related `client configuration parameter » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#chatlist-update-period>`_ ).

stories.TogglePinned.desc: Pin or unpin one or more stories

params.peer: Peer where to pin or unpin stories
params.id: IDs of stories to pin or unpin
params.pinned: Whether to pin or unpin the stories

stories.GetStoriesViews.desc: Obtain info about the view count, forward count, reactions and recent viewers of one or more `stories <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_.

params.peer: Peer whose stories should be fetched

stories.TogglePinnedToTop.desc: Pin some stories to the top of the profile, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#pinned-or-archived-stories>`_ for more info.

params.id: IDs of the stories to pin (max `stories_pinned_to_top_count_max <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#stories-pinned-to-top-count-max>`_ ).

stories.GetChatsToSend.desc: Obtain a list of channels where the user can post `stories <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_

params.peer: The peer that uploaded the story.
params.id: IDs of the stories to report.

stories.GetStoriesByID.desc: Obtain full info about a set of `stories <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_ by their IDs.

params.peer: Peer where the stories were posted

stories.TogglePeerStoriesHidden.desc: Hide the active stories of a user, preventing them from being displayed on the action bar on the homescreen, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#hiding-stories-of-other-users>`_ for more info.

params.hidden: Whether to hide or unhide stories.

stories.SearchPosts.desc: Globally search for `stories <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_ using a hashtag or a `location media area <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#location-tags>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#searching-stories>`_ for more info on the full flow.

params.area: A `mediaAreaGeoPoint <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/mediaAreaGeoPoint>`_ or a `mediaAreaVenue <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/mediaAreaVenue>`_. Note `mediaAreaGeoPoint <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/mediaAreaGeoPoint>`_ areas may be searched only if they have an associated ``address``.
params.peer: If set, returns only stories posted by this peer.
params.offset: Offset for `pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_: initially an empty string, then the ``next_offset`` from the previously returned `stories.foundStories <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/stories.foundStories>`_.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

stories.IncrementStoryViews.desc: Increment the view counter of one or more stories.

params.peer: Peer where the stories were posted.
params.id: IDs of the stories (maximum 200 at a time).

stories.ActivateStealthMode.desc: Activates `stories stealth mode <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#stealth-mode>`_, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#stealth-mode>`_ for more info.

params.past: Whether to erase views from any stories opened in the past `stories_stealth_past_period seconds » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#stories-stealth-past-period>`_, as specified by the `client configuration <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#client-configuration>`_.
params.future: Whether to hide future story views for the next `stories_stealth_future_period seconds » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#stories-stealth-future-period>`_, as specified by the `client configuration <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#client-configuration>`_.

stories.GetPeerStories.desc: Fetch the full active `story list <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#watching-stories>`_ of a specific peer.

params.peer: Peer whose stories should be fetched

stories.ToggleAllStoriesHidden.desc: Hide the active stories of a specific peer, preventing them from being displayed on the action bar on the homescreen.

params.hidden: Whether to hide or unhide all active stories of the peer

stories.GetStoryViewsList.desc: Obtain the list of users that have viewed a specific `story we posted <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_

params.just_contacts: Whether to only fetch view reaction/views made by our `contacts <https://core.telegram.org/api/contacts>`_
params.reactions_first: Whether to return `storyView <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/storyView>`_ info about users that reacted to the story (i.e. if set, the server will first sort results by view date as usual, and then also additionally sort the list by putting `storyView <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/storyView>`_ s with an associated reaction first in the list). Ignored if ``forwards_first`` is set.
params.forwards_first: If set, returns forwards and reposts first, then reactions, then other views; otherwise returns interactions sorted just by interaction date.
params.peer: Peer where the story was posted
params.offset: Offset for pagination, obtained from `stories.storyViewsList <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/stories.storyViewsList>`_. ``next_offset``
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

stories.GetStoryReactionsList.desc: Get the `reaction <https://core.telegram.org/api/reactions>`_ and interaction list of a `story <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_ posted to a channel, along with the sender of each reaction.

params.forwards_first: If set, returns forwards and reposts first, then reactions, then other views; otherwise returns interactions sorted just by interaction date.
params.reaction: Get only reactions of this type
params.offset: Offset for pagination (taken from the ``next_offset`` field of the returned `stories.StoryReactionsList <https://core.telegram.org/type/stories.StoryReactionsList>`_ ); empty in the first request.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

stories.ReadStories.desc: Mark all stories up to a certain ID as read, for a given peer; will emit an `updateReadStories <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updateReadStories>`_ update to all logged-in sessions.

params.peer: The peer whose stories should be marked as read.
params.max_id: Mark all stories up to and including this ID as read

stories.GetAllReadPeerStories.desc: Obtain the latest read story ID for all peers when first logging in, returned as a list of `updateReadStories <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/updateReadStories>`_ updates, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#watching-stories>`_ for more info.

stories.GetAlbums.desc: Get `story albums <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#story-albums>`_ created by a peer.

params.hash: The ``hash`` from a previously returned `stories.albums <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/stories.albums>`_, to avoid returning any results if they haven't changed.

stories.StartLive.desc: Start a live story, optionally using RTMP livestream mode, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#live-stories>`_ for the full flow.

params.pinned: Whether to pin the live story on the peer's profile
params.noforwards: Whether viewers must be prevented from forwarding or saving the live story
params.rtmp_stream: Create the live story in `RTMP livestream mode » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#stream-mode>`_, where one external streamer publishes all audio and video
params.peer: User, supergroup or channel that will own the live story; basic groups cannot post live stories
params.caption: Live story caption
params.privacy_rules: Privacy rules defining who can view the live story
params.random_id: Client-generated random ID used to prevent duplicate live stories. See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates#updatemessageid-updates>`_ for more info on random ID deduplication and updateMessageID mapping.
params.messages_enabled: Whether the `in-call message overlay » <https://core.telegram.org/api/group-calls#in-call-messages>`_ should be enabled
params.send_paid_messages_stars: Minimum Telegram Stars donation required from users other than the live story owner for each comment; the owner may always comment without donating, and ``0`` allows free comments for everyone

params.peer: The owned peer where to create the album.
params.title: Album name.
params.stories: Stories to add to the album.

stories.GetPeerMaxIDs.desc: Get compact `active story summaries » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#recent-story-summaries>`_ for a set of peers.

params.id: Peers whose `active story summaries » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#recent-story-summaries>`_ should be fetched.

params.add_to_recent: Whether to add this reaction to the `recent reactions list » <https://core.telegram.org/api/reactions#recent-reactions>`_.
params.peer: The peer that sent the story
params.story_id: ID of the story to react to

stories.GetPinnedStories.desc: Fetch the `stories <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#pinned-or-archived-stories>`_ pinned on a peer's profile.

params.peer: Peer whose pinned stories should be fetched
params.offset_id: `Offsets for pagination, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

stories.ExportStoryLink.desc: Generate a `story deep link <https://core.telegram.org/api/links#story-links>`_ for a specific story

params.peer: Peer where the story was posted
Peer where the album is posted.
params.offset: Offset for `pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_.
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

params.peer: Owned peer where the album is located.
params.album_id: ID of the album to delete.

stories.GetStoriesArchive.desc: Fetch the `story archive » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#pinned-or-archived-stories>`_ of a peer we control.

params.peer: Peer whose archived stories should be fetched
params.offset_id: `Offsets for pagination, for more info click here <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

params.peer: Channel/user from where to delete stories.
Peer where the albums are located.

params.pinned: Whether to add the story to the profile automatically upon expiration. If not set, the story will only be added to the archive, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories>`_ for more info.
params.noforwards: If set, disables forwards, screenshots, and downloads.
params.fwd_modified: Set this flag when reposting stories with ``fwd_from_id`` + ``fwd_from_story``, if the ``media`` was modified before reposting.
params.peer: The peer to send the story as.
params.media_areas: `Media areas <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#media-areas>`_ associated to the story, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#media-areas>`_ for more info.
params.caption: Story caption.
params.entities: `Message entities for styled text <https://core.telegram.org/api/entities>`_, if allowed by the `stories_entities client configuration parameter » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#stories-entities>`_.
params.privacy_rules: `Privacy rules <https://core.telegram.org/api/privacy>`_ for the story, indicating who can or can't view the story.
params.random_id: Unique client message ID required to prevent message resending. See `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/updates#updatemessageid-updates>`_ for more info on random ID deduplication and updateMessageID mapping.
params.period: Period after which the story is moved to archive (and to the profile if ``pinned`` is set), in seconds; must be one of ``6 * 3600``, ``12 * 3600``, ``86400``, or ``2 * 86400`` for Telegram Premium users, and ``86400`` otherwise.
params.fwd_from_id: If set, indicates that this story is a repost of story with ID ``fwd_from_story`` posted by the peer in ``fwd_from_id``.
params.fwd_from_story: If set, indicates that this story is a repost of story with ID ``fwd_from_story`` posted by the peer in ``fwd_from_id``.
params.albums: If set, adds the story to the specified albums.
params.music: If set, the audio track to play as background music for the story.

premium.GetBoostsList.desc: Obtains info about the boosts that were applied to a certain channel or supergroup (admins only)

params.gifts: Whether to return only info about boosts received from `gift codes and giveaways created by the channel/supergroup » <https://core.telegram.org/api/giveaways>`_
params.offset: Offset for pagination, obtained from `premium.boostsList <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/premium.boostsList>`_. ``next_offset``
params.limit: Maximum number of results to return, `see pagination <https://core.telegram.org/api/offsets>`_

params.400: The current user is not eligible to join the Peer-to-Peer Login Program.

premium.GetUserBoosts.desc: Returns the lists of boost that were applied to a channel/supergroup by a specific user (admins only)

premium.GetBoostsStatus.desc: Gets the current `number of boosts <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ of a channel/supergroup.

smsjobs.GetSmsJob.desc: Get info about an SMS job (official clients only).

stories.GetAllStories.desc: Fetch the List of active (or active and hidden) stories, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#watching-stories>`_ for more info on watching stories.

params.next: If ``next`` and ``state`` are both set, uses the passed ``state`` to paginate to the next results; if neither ``state`` nor ``next`` are set, fetches the initial page; if ``state`` is set and ``next`` is not set, check for changes in the active/hidden peerset, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#watching-stories>`_ for more info on the full flow.
params.hidden: If set, fetches the hidden active story list, otherwise fetches the active story list, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#watching-stories>`_ for more info on the full flow.
params.state: If ``next`` and ``state`` are both set, uses the passed ``state`` to paginate to the next results; if neither ``state`` nor ``next`` are set, fetches the initial page; if ``state`` is set and ``next`` is not set, check for changes in the active/hidden peerset, see `here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#watching-stories>`_ for more info on the full flow.

stories.UpdateAlbum.desc: Rename a `story albums » <https://core.telegram.org/api/stories#story-albums>`_, or add, delete or reorder stories in it.

params.peer: Peer where the album is posted.
params.title: New album title.
params.delete_stories: If set, deletes the specified stories from the album.
params.add_stories: If set, adds the specified stories to the album.
params.order: If set, reorders the stories in the album by their IDs.

aicompose.CreateTone.desc: Create a new custom `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_.

params.display_author: If set, the current user will be publicly credited as the author of the tone
params.emoji_id: `Custom emoji ID <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ of the tone's icon
params.title: Human-readable tone name, up to `aicompose_tone_title_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#aicompose-tone-title-length-max>`_ UTF-8 characters long
params.prompt: The prompt that describes how the AI should rephrase messages using this tone, up to `aicompose_tone_prompt_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#aicompose-tone-prompt-length-max>`_ UTF-8 characters long

aicompose.GetTone.desc: Fetch information about a single `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_, for example to resolve a shared tone deep link.

smsjobs.IsEligibleToJoin.desc: Check if we can process SMS jobs (official clients only).

params.403: The current user is not eligible to join the Peer-to-Peer Login Program.

premium.ApplyBoost.desc: Apply one or more `boosts » <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ to a peer.

params.slots: Which `boost slots <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ to assign to this peer.

aicompose.GetTones.desc: Fetch the list of saved `AI composer tones » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_ of the current user.

params.hash: Hash from a previously cached `aicompose.tones <https://core.telegram.org/constructor/aicompose.tones>`_. ``hash`` to avoid refetching the list if it hasn't changed; initially 0.

premium.GetMyBoosts.desc: Obtain which peers are we currently `boosting <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_, and how many `boost slots <https://core.telegram.org/api/boost>`_ we have left.

smsjobs.UpdateSettings.desc: Update SMS job settings (official clients only).

fragment.GetCollectibleInfo.desc: Fetch information about a `fragment collectible, see here » <https://core.telegram.org/api/fragment#fetching-info-about-fragment-collectibles>`_ for more info on the full flow.

smsjobs.GetStatus.desc: Get SMS jobs status (official clients only).

params.400: The current user hasn't joined the Peer-to-Peer Login Program.
The current user hasn't joined the Peer-to-Peer Login Program.

aicompose.UpdateTone.desc: Edit a custom `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_ previously created by the current user. Only the fields whose flag is set will be modified.

params.display_author: If set, changes whether the current user is publicly credited as the author of the tone (ternary value, can be not set, set and true, set and false).
params.emoji_id: If set, the new `custom emoji ID <https://core.telegram.org/api/custom-emoji>`_ of the tone's icon
params.title: If set, the new human-readable tone name, up to `aicompose_tone_title_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#aicompose-tone-title-length-max>`_ UTF-8 characters long
params.prompt: If set, the new prompt that describes how the AI should rephrase messages using this tone, up to `aicompose_tone_prompt_length_max » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#aicompose-tone-prompt-length-max>`_ UTF-8 characters long

aicompose.SaveTone.desc: Install or uninstall an `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_, adding it to or removing it from the list of saved tones of the current user.

params.tone: The tone to save or unsave
params.unsave: If ``false``, installs (saves) the tone; if ``true``, uninstalls (unsaves) it

smsjobs.FinishJob.desc: Finish an SMS job (official clients only).

aicompose.GetToneExample.desc: Fetch an example showing how an `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_ rephrases a sample message, used as a preview in the tone picker.

params.num: 0-based index of the example to fetch, to cycle through the available examples (there are `aicompose_tone_examples_num » <https://core.telegram.org/api/config#aicompose-tone-examples-num>`_ examples per tone)

aicompose.DeleteTone.desc: Permanently delete a custom `AI composer tone » <https://core.telegram.org/api/ai#ai-compose-tones>`_ created by the current user.
